    const externalMessageId = `initial-race-${randomUUID()}`;
    expect(await admission.recordInitialExternalAccepted({ id: reserved.intent.id, ownerNonce: reserved.ownerNonce, externalMessageId })).toBe(true);
    const acceptedIntent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: reserved.intent.id } });
    const acceptance = app.get(MessageAcceptanceService);
    const original = acceptance.acceptInTransaction.bind(acceptance);
    let firstCompletionEntered!: () => void;
    let releaseFirstCompletion!: () => void;
    const entered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { firstCompletionEntered = resolve; });
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseFirstCompletion = resolve; });
    let paused = false;
    const wrapped = vi.spyOn(acceptance, 'acceptInTransaction').mockImplementation(async (tx, input, beforeConversationMutation) => {
      if (input.externalMessageId === externalMessageId && input.senderResult && !paused && beforeConversationMutation) {
        paused = true;
        return original(tx, input, async (transaction, priorExists) => {
          firstCompletionEntered();
          await gate;
          await beforeConversationMutation(transaction, priorExists);
        });
      }
      return original(tx, input, beforeConversationMutation);
    });
    const transactionTarget = prisma as unknown as { $transaction: TransactionCall };
    const transactionOriginal = transactionTarget.$transaction.bind(prisma);
    let transactionCount = 0;
    transactionTarget.$transaction = (...args: unknown[]) => { transactionCount += 1; return transactionOriginal(...args); };
    let reconciliation: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
    try {
      reconciliation = outbound.reconcileInitial({ intent: acceptedIntent, actorId: tenant.owner.id, actorName: 'Later operator',
        validateActorInTransaction: async () => true });
      await entered;
      const echo = await acceptance.accept({
        externalMessageId, providerResourceIdentityId: selectedContext.providerResourceIdentityId,
        channelId: selectedContext.channelId, generation: selectedContext.generation, pairingEpoch: selectedContext.pairingEpoch,
        buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', contact: '5511987654321', contactType: 'PESSOA',
        conversationId, direction: 'OUT', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'First contact', authorUserId: null,
        authorName: null, senderResult: false,
      });
      expect(echo.creationWinner).toBe(true);
      releaseFirstCompletion();
      const completed = await reconciliation;
      expect(completed).toMatchObject({ externalId: externalMessageId, content: 'First contact' });
      expect(wrapped).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
      expect(transactionCount).toBe(3);
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { providerResourceIdentityId: selectedContext.providerResourceIdentityId, externalId: externalMessageId } })).toBe(1);
      expect(await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: reserved.intent.id } })).toMatchObject({ state: 'SUCCEEDED', externalMessageId });
      expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      releaseFirstCompletion();
      if (reconciliation) await reconciliation.catch(() => undefined);
      wrapped.mockRestore();
      transactionTarget.$transaction = transactionOriginal;
    }
  });

  it('does not assign or reopen the conversation when the accepted external key already has an echo row', async () => {
    const reserved = await initial();
    expect(await admission.claimInitial({ id: reserved.intent.id, ownerNonce: reserved.ownerNonce, validate: async () => true })).toBe(true);

      expect(publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    const after = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: conversationId } });
    expect(after.updatedAt).toEqual(before.updatedAt);
    expect(after.status).toBe('QUEUED');
    expect(after.attendantUserId).toBeNull();
    expect(after.attendantName).toBeNull();
    expect(after.attendantOrigin).toBeNull();
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { providerResourceIdentityId: selectedContext.providerResourceIdentityId, externalId: externalMessageId } })).toBe(1);
    expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(providerCallsBefore);
  });

  it('does not report full ordinary-send success when settlement rolls back after ACK and Message acceptance', async () => {
    await prisma.message.create({ data: {
      conversationId, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'trusted inbound fixture',
      channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', externalId: `ordinary-window-${randomUUID()}`,
      providerResourceIdentityId: selectedContext.providerResourceIdentityId, officialInboundAt: new Date(),
    } });
    const cookie = await login(app, 'dispatch-admission@example.test');
    const settleOriginal = admission.settleOrdinary.bind(admission);
    const settle = vi.spyOn(admission, 'settleOrdinary').mockImplementation((input) =>
      input.state === 'SETTLED'
        ? withTransactionFault(prisma, 'rollback', () => settleOriginal(input))
        : settleOriginal(input));
    const providerBefore = metaFake.providerCalls;
    let response: { status: number; body: Record<string, unknown> };
    try {
      response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}/messages`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({ texto: 'ordinary accepted before settlement rollback' });
    } finally {
      settle.mockRestore();
    }
    expect(response!.status).not.toBe(201);
    expect(response!.body).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' });
    expect(metaFake.providerCalls).toBe(providerBefore + 1);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(1);
    expect(await prisma.dispatchAdmission.count({ where: { conversationId, state: 'SENDING' } })).toBe(1);
  });
});

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

type TransactionCall = (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>;
async function withTransactionFault<T>(prisma: PrismaService, mode: 'commit-ack-loss' | 'rollback', action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const target = prisma as unknown as { $transaction: TransactionCall };
  const original = target.$transaction.bind(prisma);
  let injected = false;
  target.$transaction = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    if (injected) return original(...args);
    injected = true;
    if (mode === 'rollback' && typeof args[0] === 'function') {
      const callback = args[0] as (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;
      return original(async (tx: unknown) => {
        await callback(tx);
        throw new Error('synthetic ambiguity classification rollback');
      }, ...args.slice(1));
    }
    return original(...args).then(() => { throw new Error('synthetic ambiguity classification ACK loss'); });
  };
  try { return await action(); }
  finally { target.$transaction = original; }
}

async function waitForActorGrantShareLock(prisma: PrismaService): Promise<void> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 500; attempt += 1) {
    const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ waiting: boolean }>>`
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_activity
        WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND query ILIKE '%FOR SHARE OF u, r, b%'
      ) AS waiting`;
    if (rows[0]?.waiting) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 10));
  }
  throw new Error('Timed out waiting for the current actor/grant share lock.');
}

    const initialMessages = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } });
    let enter!: () => void;
    let release!: () => void;
    let entered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enter = resolve; });
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    evolutionFake.sendHook = async () => { enter(); await gate; };
    let drainOriginal: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
    const measurements: Array<{ wave: number; requests: number; replay202: number; posts: number; messages: number; elapsedMs: number }> = [];
    try {
      for (let wave = 0; wave < 5; wave += 1) {
        const message = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: `BCI onda ${wave + 1}` };
        const preview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
          .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
          .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message }).expect(200);
        const payload = { channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message,
          previewFingerprint: preview.body.previewFingerprint };
        const key = `c4e13e0${wave + 1}-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d4`;
        const before = Date.now();
        const postsBefore = evolutionFake.enviados.length;
        const intentsBefore = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.count({ where: { conversationId } });
        const original = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
          .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', key).send(payload)
          .then((response) => response);
        drainOriginal = original;
        await entered;
        const replays = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 19 }, () => request(app.getHttpServer())
          .post(`${base}/initial-messages`).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
          .set('Idempotency-Key', key).send(payload).then((response) => response)));
        expect(replays.map((response) => response.status)).toEqual(Array(19).fill(202));
        release();
        const first = await original;
        drainOriginal = null;
        expect(first.status).toBe(201);
        expect(first.body.attempt.state).toBe('SUCCEEDED');
        expect(evolutionFake.enviados.length - postsBefore).toBe(1);
        expect(await prisma.initialMessageIntent.count({ where: { conversationId } })).toBe(intentsBefore + 1);
        const durationMs = Date.now() - before;
        expect(durationMs).toBeLessThan(15_000);
        const messagesThisWave = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } }) - initialMessages - wave;
        expect(messagesThisWave).toBe(1);
        measurements.push({ wave: wave + 1, requests: 20, replay202: replays.length, posts: evolutionFake.enviados.length - postsBefore,
          messages: messagesThisWave,
          elapsedMs: durationMs });
        if (wave < 4) {
          let nextEnter!: () => void;
          let nextRelease!: () => void;
          entered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { nextEnter = resolve; });
          const nextGate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { nextRelease = resolve; });
          evolutionFake.sendHook = async () => { nextEnter(); await nextGate; };
          release = nextRelease;
          enter = nextEnter;
        }
      }
    } finally {
      release();
      evolutionFake.sendHook = null;
      if (drainOriginal) await drainOriginal.catch(() => undefined);
    }
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(initialCount + 5);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(initialMessages + 5);
    expect(measurements).toHaveLength(5);
    process.stdout.write(`ST04_BCI_5x20 ${JSON.stringify(measurements)}\n`);
  });

  it('requires an empty ACK body, explicit risk header, and elapsed immutable deadline at the BFF', async () => {
    const base = `/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}`;
    const message = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: 'Ambiguous BFF acknowledgment fixture' };
    const preview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message }).expect(200);
    evolutionFake.sendIdNull = true;
    try {
      const sent = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', 'a4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d5')
        .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message, previewFingerprint: preview.body.previewFingerprint }).expect(409);
      expect(sent.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'INITIAL_SEND_AMBIGUOUS', outcome: 'AMBIGUOUS', state: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
      const attemptId = sent.body.attemptId as string;
      expect(attemptId).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
      const ackPath = `${base}/initial-messages/${attemptId}/acknowledge`;
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .set('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk', 'true').send({ confirm: true }).expect(400);
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .send({}).expect(409).expect(({ body }) => expect(body.code).toBe('DUPLICATION_RISK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED'));
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .set('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk', 'true').send({}).expect(409)
        .expect(({ body }) => expect(body.code).toBe('ACK_TOO_EARLY'));
      await prisma.initialMessageIntent.update({ where: { id: attemptId }, data: { dispatchDeadlineAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) } });
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .set('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk', 'true').send({}).expect(200);
      const intent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: attemptId } });
      expect(intent).toMatchObject({ state: 'AMBIGUOUS', slotReleasedAt: expect.any(Date), riskAcknowledgedAt: expect.any(Date) });
      expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      evolutionFake.sendIdNull = false;
    }
  });

  it.each([
    ['commit-ack-loss', 409, 'AMBIGUOUS', true],
    ['rollback', 503, undefined, false],
  ] as const)('classifies an unknown provider result only from durable exact state (%s)', async (fault, status, expectedState, committed) => {
    const base = `/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}`;
    const message = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: `Unknown classification ${fault}` };
    const preview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message }).expect(200);
    const admission = app.get(DispatchAdmissionService);
    const original = admission.markInitialAmbiguous.bind(admission);
    const mark = vi.spyOn(admission, 'markInitialAmbiguous').mockImplementation((input) =>
      withTransactionFault(prisma, fault, () => original(input)));
    evolutionFake.sendIdNull = true;
    try {
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .set('Idempotency-Key', fault === 'rollback' ? 'b4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d7' : 'b4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d8')
        .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: message, previewFingerprint: preview.body.previewFingerprint })
        .expect(status);
      if (committed) expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'INITIAL_SEND_AMBIGUOUS', state: expectedState });
      else {
        expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'INITIAL_DISPATCH_UNCONFIRMED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN' });
        expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('state');
      }
      expect(mark).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(1);
      const attemptId = response.body.attemptId as string;
      expect(attemptId).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
      const intent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: attemptId } });
      expect(intent).toMatchObject({ state: committed ? 'AMBIGUOUS' : 'SENDING', slotReleasedAt: null });
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      mark.mockRestore();
      evolutionFake.sendIdNull = false;
    }
  });

  it('previews and sends approved NAMED and POSITIONAL templates outside the window on the selected Meta account', async () => {
    const official = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, businessUnitId, 'OFICIAL', '111111111', { requiresWindow: true });
    await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: official.channel.id }, data: { wabaId: '123456789' } });
    const templates = [
      { id: 'template-named', name: 'initial_named', language: 'en_US', status: 'APPROVED', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',
        components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Hello {{name}}', example: { body_text_named_params: [{ param_name: 'name', example: 'Ada' }] } }] },
      { id: 'template-positional', name: 'initial_positional', language: 'en_US', status: 'APPROVED', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'POSITIONAL',
        components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Hello {{2}} before {{1}}, then {{2}}', example: { body_text: [['first', 'second']] } }] },
      { id: 'template-buttons', name: 'initial_buttons', language: 'en_US', status: 'APPROVED', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',
        components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Hello', example: { body_text: [['Hello']] } }, { type: 'BUTTONS', buttons: [{ type: 'QUICK_REPLY', text: 'Confirm' }] }] },
    ];
    const graphRequests: Array<{ url: string; method: string; body: Record<string, unknown> | null }> = [];
    let grantTargets = ['123456789'];
    let denyMessagingGrant = false;
    let statusOverride: string | null = null;
    let overflowTemplateList = false;
    let twoPageTemplateList = false;
    let duplicateTemplateResult = false;
    let changeTemplateDefinition = false;
    let twoPageMembership = false;
    let phoneReadLatch: { enter: () => void; gate: Promise<void> } | null = null;
    let postLatch: { enter: () => void; gate: Promise<void> } | null = null;
    const originalMembershipVerifier = metaFake.verificarNumeroVinculado;
    metaFake.verificarNumeroVinculado = (wabaId, phoneNumberId, accessToken) =>
      new MetaHttpClient().verificarNumeroVinculado(wabaId, phoneNumberId, accessToken);
    const armPhoneRead = () => {
      let enter!: () => void;
      let release!: () => void;
      const entered = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enter = resolve; });
      const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
      phoneReadLatch = { enter, gate };
      return { entered, release: () => { release(); phoneReadLatch = null; } };
    };
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = init?.method ?? 'GET';
      let body: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
      if (typeof init?.body === 'string') body = JSON.parse(init.body) as Record<string, unknown>;
      graphRequests.push({ url, method, body });
      if (url.includes('/phone_numbers')) {
        if (phoneReadLatch) {
          const latch = phoneReadLatch;
          latch.enter();
          await latch.gate;
        }
        const after = new URL(url).searchParams.get('after');
        const phonePage = twoPageMembership && !after
          ? { data: Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `unrelated-${index}`, display_phone_number: '+55 11 00000-0000' })), paging: { next: 'https://graph.facebook.com/next', cursors: { after: 'phone-page-2' } } }
          : { data: [{ id: '111111111', display_phone_number: '+55 11 98765-4321' }] };
        return new Response(JSON.stringify(phonePage), { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
      }
      if (url.includes('/debug_token?')) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ data: {
        app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true, scopes: denyMessagingGrant ? ['whatsapp_business_management'] : ['whatsapp_business_management', 'whatsapp_business_messaging'],
        granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: grantTargets },
          ...(!denyMessagingGrant ? [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_messaging', target_ids: grantTargets }] : [])],
      } }), { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?')) {
        const name = new URL(url).searchParams.get('name');
        const after = new URL(url).searchParams.get('after');
        const matching = templates.filter((template) => !name || template.name === name)
          .map((template) => statusOverride ? { ...template, status: statusOverride } : template)
          .map((template) => changeTemplateDefinition && template.id === 'template-named'
            ? { ...template, components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Changed {{name}}', example: { body_text_named_params: [{ param_name: 'name', example: 'Ada' }] } }] }
            : template);
        if (twoPageTemplateList) return new Response(JSON.stringify(after
          ? { data: matching }
          : { data: [], paging: { cursors: { after: 'template-page-2' }, next: 'https://graph.facebook.com/next' } }),
        { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
        if (overflowTemplateList) return new Response(JSON.stringify(after
          ? { data: matching, paging: { cursors: { after: 'third-page' }, next: 'fixture:next' } }
          : { data: [], paging: { cursors: { after: 'second-page' }, next: 'fixture:next' } }),
        { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
        const data = duplicateTemplateResult && matching[0] ? [...matching, matching[0]] : matching;
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ data }),
          { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
      }
      if (url.endsWith('/111111111/messages') && method === 'POST') {
        if (postLatch) {
          const latch = postLatch;
          latch.enter();
          await latch.gate;
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', messages: [{ id: `wamid-template-${graphRequests.filter((entry) => entry.method === 'POST').length}` }] }),
          { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'unexpected fixture request' } }),
        { status: 404, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });
    }));
    metaFake.confirmHook = async () => {
      const latch = phoneReadLatch;
      if (!latch) return;
      latch.enter();
      await latch.gate;
    };
    try {
      const catalog = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`/api/bff/business-units/${businessUnitId}/channels/${official.channel.id}/message-template-catalog`)

        } }).expect(409).expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({ code: 'INITIAL_TEMPLATE_UNSUPPORTED' }));
      expect(graphRequests.filter((entry) => entry.method === 'POST' && entry.url.endsWith('/111111111/messages'))).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(await prisma.initialMessageIntent.count({ where: { conversationId } })).toBe(0);
      const inboundWindowSeed = await prisma.message.create({ data: {

      const textPreview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .send({ channelId: official.channel.id, expectedGeneration: official.channel.generation, mensagem: textMessage }).expect(200);
      const windowLatch = armPhoneRead();
      const windowKey = 'c4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d6';
      const postsBeforeWindow = graphRequests.filter((entry) => entry.method === 'POST' && entry.url.endsWith('/111111111/messages')).length;
      const windowSend = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)

        .send({ channelId: official.channel.id, expectedGeneration: official.channel.generation, mensagem: textMessage,
          previewFingerprint: textPreview.body.previewFingerprint }).then((response) => response);
      try {
        await windowLatch.entered;
        await prisma.message.update({ where: { id: inboundWindowSeed.id }, data: {
          officialInboundAt: new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 - 1_000),
        } });
        windowLatch.release();
        const blocked = await windowSend;
        expect(blocked.status).toBe(409);
        expect(blocked.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'BLOCKED' });
        expect(graphRequests.filter((entry) => entry.method === 'POST' && entry.url.endsWith('/111111111/messages'))).toHaveLength(postsBeforeWindow);
        const windowIntent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: {

      const delayedPreview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .send({ channelId: official.channel.id, expectedGeneration: official.channel.generation, mensagem: delayedMessage }).expect(200);
      const delayedKey = 'c4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d4';
      const messagesBeforeDelay = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } });
      const leaseRead = armPhoneRead();
      const delayedSend = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', delayedKey)
        .send({ channelId: official.channel.id, expectedGeneration: official.channel.generation, mensagem: delayedMessage,
          previewFingerprint: delayedPreview.body.previewFingerprint }).then((response) => response);
      try {
        await leaseRead.entered;
        const waitingIntent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: {
          buId_actorId_idempotencyKey: { buId: businessUnitId, actorId: (await prisma.appUser.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { email: 'initial-journey@leadshug.test' } })).id, idempotencyKey: delayedKey },
        } });
        await prisma.initialMessageIntent.update({ where: { id: waitingIntent.id }, data: { leaseExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1) } });
        leaseRead.release();
        const blocked = await delayedSend;

      expect(boundedProtocol.filter((entry) => entry.url.includes('/message_templates?'))).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(boundedProtocol.filter((entry) => entry.url.includes('/phone_numbers'))).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(Date.now() - boundedAt).toBeLessThan(75_000);

        { type: 'text', text: 'first' }, { type: 'text', text: 'second' },

      expect(metaFake.enviados).toHaveLength(0);

      const noDispatchCases: Array<{ label: string; mode: () => void; reset: () => void; key: string; expectedCode?: string }> = [

        { label: 'unknown-status', mode: () => { statusOverride = 'UNKNOWN'; }, reset: () => { statusOverride = null; }, key: 'e4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d5' },
        { label: 'off-account', mode: () => { grantTargets = ['another-account']; }, reset: () => { grantTargets = ['123456789']; }, key: 'c4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d5', expectedCode: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY' },
        { label: 'missing-messaging-grant', mode: () => { denyMessagingGrant = true; }, reset: () => { denyMessagingGrant = false; }, key: 'e4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d6', expectedCode: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY' },
        { label: 'two-page-overflow', mode: () => { overflowTemplateList = true; }, reset: () => { overflowTemplateList = false; }, key: 'd4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d5' },

        { label: 'duplicate-template-id', mode: () => { duplicateTemplateResult = true; }, reset: () => { duplicateTemplateResult = false; }, key: 'b4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d6' },

  it('requires the immutable deadline for local risk release of known acceptance and permits a new successor without resend', async () => {
    const actorId = await criarUsuario(prisma, mantenedoraId, businessUnitId, 'initial-risk-ack@leadshug.test', 'ATENDENTE');
    const actorCookie = await login(app, 'initial-risk-ack@leadshug.test');
    const base = `/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}`;
    const mensagem = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: 'Known external acceptance without local completion' };
    const preview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
      .set('Cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem }).expect(200);
    let enter!: () => void;
    let release!: () => void;
    const atProvider = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enter = resolve; });
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    evolutionFake.sendHook = async () => { enter(); await gate; };
    let pending: Promise<{ status: number; body: Record<string, unknown> }> | null = null;
    try {
      pending = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
        .set('Cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', randomUUID())
        .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem, previewFingerprint: preview.body.previewFingerprint })
        .then((response) => response);
      await atProvider;
      await prisma.userBuRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: actorId, buId: businessUnitId } });
      release();
      const incomplete = await pending;
      expect(incomplete.status).toBe(503);
      expect(incomplete.body).toMatchObject({ state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
        receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', recoveryAction: 'RECONCILE' });
    } finally {
      release();
      evolutionFake.sendHook = null;
      if (pending) await pending.catch(() => undefined);
    }

    const intent = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId } });
    const currentId = await criarUsuario(prisma, mantenedoraId, businessUnitId, 'initial-risk-reviewer@leadshug.test', 'ATENDENTE');
    const currentCookie = await login(app, 'initial-risk-reviewer@leadshug.test');
    const currentAttempt = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`${base}/initial-messages/${intent.id}`).set('Cookie', currentCookie).expect(200);
    expect(currentAttempt.body).toMatchObject({ state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', riskAcknowledgementAvailable: true,
      providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED' });
    const ackPath = `${base}/initial-messages/${intent.id}/acknowledge`;
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', currentCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .set('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk', 'true').send({}).expect(409)
      .expect(({ body }) => expect(body).toMatchObject({ code: 'ACK_TOO_EARLY', eligibleAt: expect.any(String) }));
    const ackBeforeProvider = evolutionFake.enviados.length;
    await prisma.initialMessageIntent.update({ where: { id: intent.id }, data: { dispatchDeadlineAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) } });
    const acknowledged = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(ackPath).set('Cookie', currentCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .set('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk', 'true').send({}).expect(200);
    expect(acknowledged.body).toMatchObject({ id: intent.id, state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', slotReleasedAt: expect.any(String) });
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(ackBeforeProvider);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
    const releasedOriginal = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: intent.id } });
    expect(releasedOriginal).toMatchObject({
      externalMessageId: expect.any(String), slotReleasedAt: expect.any(Date), riskAcknowledgedAt: expect.any(Date),
    });
    expect(releasedOriginal.slotReleasedAt!.toISOString()).toBe(acknowledged.body.slotReleasedAt);

    const successorText = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: 'New explicit send after released slot' };
    const successorPreview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
      .set('Cookie', currentCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: successorText }).expect(200);
    const successor = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
      .set('Cookie', currentCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', randomUUID())
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem: successorText,
        previewFingerprint: successorPreview.body.previewFingerprint }).expect(201);
    expect(successor.body.attempt.id).not.toBe(intent.id);
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(ackBeforeProvider + 1);
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(1);
    const successorConversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: conversationId } });
    const providerCallsBeforeLateRecovery = evolutionFake.providerCalls;
    const lateRecovery = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages/${intent.id}/reconcile`)
      .set('Cookie', currentCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    expect(lateRecovery.body).toMatchObject({ id: intent.id, state: 'SUCCEEDED', slotReleasedAt: expect.any(String) });
    expect(await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: successor.body.attempt.id } }))
      .toMatchObject({ state: 'SUCCEEDED', slotReleasedAt: expect.any(Date) });
    expect(await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: intent.id } }))
      .toMatchObject({ state: 'SUCCEEDED', slotReleasedAt: releasedOriginal.slotReleasedAt });
    expect(await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: conversationId } }))
      .toMatchObject({ status: successorConversation.status, attendantUserId: successorConversation.attendantUserId,
        attendantName: successorConversation.attendantName, attendantOrigin: successorConversation.attendantOrigin });
    expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(2);
    expect(evolutionFake.providerCalls).toBe(providerCallsBeforeLateRecovery);
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(ackBeforeProvider + 1);
    expect(currentId).not.toBe(actorId);
  });

  it('keeps known provider acceptance explicit when the current grant is revoked before local Message commit', async () => {
    const actorId = await criarUsuario(prisma, mantenedoraId, businessUnitId, 'initial-revoked@leadshug.test', 'ATENDENTE');
    const actorCookie = await login(app, 'initial-revoked@leadshug.test');

    const mensagem = { tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: 'Grant revocation fence' };
    const preview = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-message-preview`)
      .set('Cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem }).expect(200);
    let enter!: () => void;
    let release!: () => void;
    const atProvider = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { enter = resolve; });
    const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
    evolutionFake.sendHook = async () => { enter(); await gate; };
    const pending = request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages`)
      .set('Cookie', actorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').set('Idempotency-Key', 'c4e13e0a-1a63-4bfc-8cc0-11bd490b01d4')
      .send({ channelId, expectedGeneration: generation, mensagem, previewFingerprint: preview.body.previewFingerprint })
      .then((response) => response);
    try {
      await atProvider;
      await prisma.userBuRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: actorId, buId: businessUnitId } });
      release();
      const response = await pending;
      expect(response.status).toBe(503);
      expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ code: 'INITIAL_LOCAL_ACCEPTANCE_UNCONFIRMED', state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
        providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', recoveryAction: 'RECONCILE' });
      expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('externalMessageId');
      expect(await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } })).toBe(0);
      const attempt = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId } });
      expect(attempt).toMatchObject({ state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', externalMessageId: expect.stringMatching(/^evo-enviado-/) });
    } finally {
      release();
      evolutionFake.sendHook = null;
    }
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(1);

    const originalAttempt = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId } });
    const originalRequest = originalAttempt.request as { originalActorName: string };
    const currentActorId = await criarUsuario(prisma, mantenedoraId, businessUnitId, 'initial-current-reconciler@leadshug.test', 'ATENDENTE');
    const currentActorCookie = await login(app, 'initial-current-reconciler@leadshug.test');
    const providerCallsBeforeRecovery = evolutionFake.enviados.length;
    const recovered = await request(app.getHttpServer()).post(`${base}/initial-messages/${originalAttempt.id}/reconcile`)
      .set('Cookie', currentActorCookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste').send({}).expect(200);
    expect(recovered.body).toMatchObject({ id: originalAttempt.id, state: 'SUCCEEDED', localMessageState: 'RECORDED', recoveryAction: null });
    const localMessage = await prisma.message.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { conversationId, direction: 'OUT' } });
    expect(localMessage).toMatchObject({ authorUserId: actorId, authorName: originalRequest.originalActorName });
    expect(currentActorId).not.toBe(actorId);
    expect(evolutionFake.enviados).toHaveLength(providerCallsBeforeRecovery);
  });
});

import { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/infra/prisma/prisma.service';
import { sealChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-crypto';
import { OutboundService } from '../src/domain/inbox/outbound.service';
import { Channel, type ChannelMessage, type ChannelMessageKind, type ChannelSendOptions, type ChannelSendResult, type TextMessage } from '../src/domain/channels/transport/channel';
import { ChannelAdapterFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-factory';
import { ChannelAdapterRegistry } from '../src/integrations/channels/channel-adapter-registry';
import type { ResolvedChannelCredential } from '../src/domain/channels/channel-credential-resolver';
import { MetaChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/meta-channel';
import { EvolutionChannelFactory } from '../src/integrations/channels/evolution-channel';
import { MetaHttpClient } from '../src/integrations/meta/meta.client';
import { MetaInitialMessageClient } from '../src/integrations/meta/initial-message.client';
import {
  contratarCanalNaoOficial, criarCanalVerificado, criarMantenedora, evolutionFake, limparBanco, login, metaFake, subirApp,
} from './helpers';

class OpaqueRecipientChannel extends Channel {
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  readonly supportedKinds: readonly ChannelMessageKind[] = Object.freeze(['text']);
  async sendMessage(message: ChannelMessage, options?: ChannelSendOptions): Promise<ChannelSendResult> {
    if (message.kind !== 'text') return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'UNSUPPORTED_KIND' };
    let claimed: boolean;
    try { claimed = await options?.beforeDispatch?.() ?? false; } catch { claimed = false; }
    if (!claimed) return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
    this.sent.push(message);
    return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: `opaque-fake-${this.sent.length}` };
  }
}

class OpaqueRecipientFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  constructor(private readonly sent: TextMessage[]) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return true; }
  create() { return new OpaqueRecipientChannel(this.sent); }
}

class MutatingMetaFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new MetaChannelFactory(metaFake, new MetaInitialMessageClient(metaFake));
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

class MutatingEvolutionFactory extends ChannelAdapterFactory {
  readonly origin = 'NAO_OFICIAL' as const;
  private readonly delegate = new EvolutionChannelFactory(evolutionFake);
  constructor(private readonly mutateBeforeFence: () => Promise<void>) { super(); }
  locallyConfigured() { return this.delegate.locallyConfigured(); }
  create(credential: ResolvedChannelCredential, beforeDispatch: () => Promise<boolean>) {
    return this.delegate.create(credential, async () => {
      await this.mutateBeforeFence();
      return beforeDispatch();
    });
  }
}

  it('blocks real binding changes inside Meta/Evolution adapter pre-dispatch callbacks', async () => {
    const cases = [

    for (const { provider, changed } of cases) {

  it('completes five real-PostgreSQL rounds of twenty overlapping sends with one accepted Message each', async () => {
    const operationsPerRound = 20;

    const acceptedCounts: number[] = [];
    const recordedCounts: number[] = [];
    const perOwnedConversationRowCounts: number[][] = [];
    for (let round = 0; round < 5; round += 1) {
      const conversations = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: operationsPerRound }, (_, index) => prisma.conversation.create({ data: {
        buId, contact: `user:opaque-${round}-${index}`, contactType: 'PESSOA', status: 'QUEUED',
      } })));
      await Promise.all(conversations.map(({ id }) => seedHistoricalInbound(prisma, id, buId)));
      let arrivals = 0;
      let markBarrier!: () => void;
      let release!: () => void;
      const barrier = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { markBarrier = resolve; });
      const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; });
      metaFake.sendHook = async () => {
        arrivals += 1;
        if (arrivals === operationsPerRound) markBarrier();
        await gate;
      };
      const pending = conversations.map((conversation, index) => request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversation.id}/messages`).set('Cookie', cookie).set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
        .send({ texto: `round ${round} outbound ${index}` }).then((response) => response, (error) => ({ status: 0, error })));
      let responses: Array<{ status: number }>;
      let barrierTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      try {
        await Promise.race([barrier, new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
          barrierTimer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('overlap barrier timed out')), 20_000);
        })]);
      } finally {
        if (barrierTimer) clearTimeout(barrierTimer);
        release();
        responses = await Promise.all(pending);
        metaFake.sendHook = null;
      }
      const accepted = responses.filter((response) => response.status === 201).length;
      const recorded = await prisma.message.count({ where: { conversationId: { in: conversations.map(({ id }) => id) }, direction: 'OUT' } });
      const groupedRows = await prisma.message.groupBy({
        by: ['conversationId'],
        where: { conversationId: { in: conversations.map(({ id }) => id) }, direction: 'OUT' },
        _count: { _all: true },
      });
      const rowCountByConversation = new Map(groupedRows.map((row) => [row.conversationId, row._count._all]));
      const ownedConversationRowCounts = conversations.map(({ id }) => rowCountByConversation.get(id) ?? 0);
      operationCounts.push(responses.length);
      acceptedCounts.push(accepted);
      recordedCounts.push(recorded);
      perOwnedConversationRowCounts.push(ownedConversationRowCounts);
      expect(accepted).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(recorded).toBe(operationsPerRound);
      expect(ownedConversationRowCounts).toEqual(Array(operationsPerRound).fill(1));
    }
    console.log(`[CHANNEL-OUTBOUND-OVERLAP]${JSON.stringify({ repetitions: 5, operationsPerRepetition: operationsPerRound, operationCounts, acceptedCounts, recordedCounts, perOwnedConversationRowCounts, limits: 'Disposable PostgreSQL and provider fake; each distinct owned conversation has exactly one OUT row in this bounded fixture; no same-key exactly-once, capacity, or SLO claim.' })}`);
  });
});

/**
 * Liga o canal não oficial nos DOIS níveis: o teto da instalação (env, lido no
 * boot do serviço) e o contrato da Mantenedora (banco) — ADR-0016.
 *
 * Precisa vir ANTES de `subirApp`, porque o teto é lido uma vez na construção.
 * É o mesmo que acontece em produção: mudar módulo de instalação é deploy.
 */
export function tetoComCanalNaoOficial(): void {
  process.env.LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL = 'true';
}

export async function contratarCanalNaoOficial(prisma: PrismaService, mantenedoraId: string): Promise<void> {
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.upsert({
    where: { mantenedoraId },
    create: { mantenedoraId, modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
    update: { modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } },
  });
}

export async function subirApp(registryOverride?: ChannelAdapterRegistry, captureQueries = false): Promise<{ app: INestApplication; prisma: PrismaService }> {
  process.env.SESSION_SECRET ||= 'segredo-de-teste';
  process.env.INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN = TOKEN_INTERNO;
  process.env.META_APP_ID = 'fixture-app';
  process.env.META_APP_SECRET = META_APP_SECRET;
  process.env.META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID = 'fixture-config';
  process.env.GRAPH_VERSION = 'v26.0';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://api.example.test/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN = 'verify-token-de-teste';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'fixture-key-v1';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY = Buffer.alloc(32, 17).toString('base64');

  const testingModule = Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT)
    .useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT)
    .useValue(evolutionFake)
    .overrideProvider(TYPEBOT_CLIENT)
    .useValue(typebotFake);
  if (captureQueries) {
    testingModule.overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue(new PrismaService({ log: [{ emit: 'event', level: 'query' }] }));
  }

/** Test channel fixture with the same durable ownership and credential invariants as production. */
export async function criarCanalVerificado(
  prisma: PrismaService,
  buId: string,
  type: 'OFICIAL' | 'NAO_OFICIAL',
  externalResourceId: string,
  options: { status?: 'CONECTADO' | 'CONECTANDO' | 'DESCONECTADO'; requiresWindow?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const channel = await prisma.buChannel.create({ data: {
    buId, type, status: options.status ?? 'CONECTADO', requiresWindow: options.requiresWindow ?? type === 'OFICIAL',
    ...(type === 'OFICIAL' ? { phoneNumberId: externalResourceId } : { evolutionInstanceName: externalResourceId }),
    ownNumberVerified: true, verifiedEpoch: 0, providerConnectionState: type === 'OFICIAL' ? 'SUBSCRIBED' : 'CONNECTED',
    receiptVerifiedAt: new Date(),
  } });
  const priorIdentity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findUnique({
    where: { provider_externalResourceId: { provider: type, externalResourceId } },
  });
  if (priorIdentity && (priorIdentity.buId !== buId || priorIdentity.currentChannelId)) {
    throw new Error('Fixture resource identity is owned or active elsewhere.');
  }
  const identity = priorIdentity
    ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.update({ where: { id: priorIdentity.id }, data: { currentChannelId: channel.id, retiredAt: null, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE' } })
    : await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.create({ data: {
      provider: type, externalResourceId, buId, currentChannelId: channel.id, managedLifecycle: true, cleanupState: 'ACTIVE',
    } });
  if (type === 'OFICIAL') {
    const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID!;
    const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY!, 'base64');
    const envelope = sealChannelCredential('fixture-scoped-token', keyId, key, {
      purpose: 'active', provider: type, buId, channelId: channel.id, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
    });
    await prisma.channelCredential.create({ data: {
      channelId: channel.id, provider: type, buId, generation: channel.generation, version: 1,
      keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce), ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
    } });
  }
  return { channel, identity };
}

/** Cria uma Mantenedora pela superfície interna — o caminho real de bootstrap. */
/**
 * Cria a Mantenedora **com o onboarding já concluído**.
 *
 * O bootstrap a cria PENDENTE (ADR-0016 §4), e é assim em produção. Os testes
 * que exercitam o produto vêm depois do wizard; quem exercita o portão é
 * `onboarding.e2e-spec.ts`, que usa `criarMantenedoraPendente`.
 */
export async function criarMantenedora(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const r = await criarMantenedoraPendente(app, nome, email, senha);
  const prisma = app.get(PrismaService);
  await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.update({
    where: { mantenedoraId: r.mantenedora.id },
    data: { onboardingConcluido: true },
  });
  return r;
}

export async function criarMantenedoraPendente(
  app: INestApplication,
  nome: string,
  email: string,
  senha = 'senha-de-teste-1',
) {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/internal/mantenedoras')
    .set('x-internal-token', TOKEN_INTERNO)
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ nome, bu: { nome: `Número da ${nome}`, telefone: '5584999990000' }, owner: { nome: 'Dono', email, senha } })
    .expect(201);
  return res.body as {
    mantenedora: { id: string; nome: string };
    businessUnit: { id: string; nome: string };
    owner: { id: string; email: string };
  };
}

/** Faz login e devolve o cookie de sessão para reusar nas próximas chamadas. */
export async function login(app: INestApplication, email: string, senha = 'senha-de-teste-1'): Promise<string> {
  const res = await request(app.getHttpServer())
    .post('/api/bff/auth/login')
    .set('x-requested-with', 'teste')
    .send({ email, senha })
    .expect(200);
  const setCookie = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  return setCookie[0].split(';')[0];
}

      if (data.holds && typeof data.holds === 'object') onboarding.holds = { ...data.holds };
      if (data.holdsAfter && typeof data.holdsAfter === 'object') onboarding.holdsAfter = { ...data.holdsAfter };
      if (data.ambiguousAfter && typeof data.ambiguousAfter === 'object') onboarding.ambiguousAfter = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.ambiguousAfter).map(([k, v]) => [k, { remaining: Math.max(1, Number(v.remaining ?? 1)) }]));
      return json(res, 200, { configured: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/template-binding-proof') {
      const { buId, channelId, draftIds, accountA, accountB } = data;
      if (typeof buId !== 'string' || typeof channelId !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(draftIds)
        || draftIds.length < 1 || draftIds.length > 2 || draftIds.some((id) => typeof id !== 'string')
        || typeof accountA !== 'string' || typeof accountB !== 'string') return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid binding proof scope' });
      const [drafts, channel] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findMany({ where: { id: { in: draftIds }, buId, channelId }, select: { id: true, accountReference: true } }),
        prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { id: channelId, buId }, select: { wabaId: true } }),
      ]);
      if (!channel || drafts.length !== draftIds.length) return json(res, 404, { error: 'binding proof target not found' });
      const accountReference = (wabaId) => createHash('sha256').update(`meta-waba\0${wabaId}`).digest('hex');
      return json(res, 200, { drafts: drafts.map((draft) => ({ draftId: draft.id,
        boundToAccountA: draft.accountReference === accountReference(accountA),
        boundToAccountB: draft.accountReference === accountReference(accountB),
      })), currentChannelMatchesAccountB: channel.wabaId === accountB });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/meta/request') {
      let graphUrl;
      try { graphUrl = new URL(String(data.url)); } catch { return json(res, 400, { error: { code: 100 } }); }
      const parts = graphUrl.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
      const authorization = String(data.authorization ?? '');
      const token = authorization.startsWith('Bearer ') ? authorization.slice(7) : '';
      if (parts[2] === 'messages' && data.method === 'POST') {
        const phoneNumberId = parts[1];
        const resource = providerInventory.get(phoneNumberId);
        if (!resource || token !== `timeline-scoped-token:${phoneNumberId}`) return json(res, 403, { error: { code: 10, message: 'verified scoped resource required' } });
        await providerCall('meta.initial.send', { phoneNumberId });
        await providerEffect('meta.initial.send', { phoneNumberId });
        return json(res, 200, onboarding.meta.sendMode === 'unknown'
          ? { messaging_product: 'whatsapp', contacts: [{ wa_id: 'fixture' }], messages: [{}] }
          : { messaging_product: 'whatsapp', contacts: [{ wa_id: 'fixture' }], messages: [{ id: `timeline-initial-${onboarding.calls.filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.initial.send').length}` }] });
      }
      onboarding.meta.templateCalls ??= [];
      const templateOperation = parts[1] === 'debug_token' ? 'meta.template.debug-token'
        : parts[2] === 'message_templates' && data.method === 'POST' ? 'meta.template.create'
          : parts[2] === 'message_templates' ? 'meta.template.list' : 'meta.template.get';
      onboarding.meta.templateCalls.push({ operation: templateOperation });
      await providerCall(templateOperation);
      if (parts[1] === 'debug_token') {
        const inputToken = graphUrl.searchParams.get('input_token') ?? '';
        const encoded = inputToken.startsWith('timeline-code-token:') ? inputToken.slice('timeline-code-token:'.length) : '';
        const code = encoded ? Buffer.from(encoded, 'base64url').toString() : '';
        const configured = onboarding.meta.templateGrant ?? {};
        const resources = onboarding.meta.grants?.[code]?.resources ?? [];
        const scopedResourceId = inputToken.startsWith('timeline-scoped-token:')
          ? inputToken.slice('timeline-scoped-token:'.length) : '';
        const scopedResource = scopedResourceId ? providerInventory.get(scopedResourceId) : null;
        const waba = scopedResource?.wabaId
          ?? resources.map((id) => onboarding.resources.find((item) => item.id === id)?.wabaId).find(Boolean);
        return json(res, 200, { data: { app_id: configured.appId ?? 'fixture-app', is_valid: configured.valid ?? true,
          scopes: configured.scopes ?? ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: configured.targets ?? (waba ? [waba] : []) }] } });
      }
      const resources = token.startsWith('timeline-scoped-token:')
        ? [providerInventory.get(token.slice('timeline-scoped-token:'.length))].filter(Boolean)
        : [...Object.entries(onboarding.meta.grants ?? {})].flatMap(([code, grant]) => {
          const expected = `timeline-code-token:${Buffer.from(code).toString('base64url')}`;
          return token === expected ? (grant.resources ?? []).map((id) => onboarding.resources.find((item) => item.id === id)).filter(Boolean) : [];
        });
      onboarding.meta.templates ??= {};
      const wabaId = parts[1];
      if (parts[2] === 'message_templates' && !resources.some((item) => item.wabaId === wabaId)) {
        return json(res, 403, { error: { code: 10 } });
      }
      const templates = onboarding.meta.templates[wabaId] ?? (onboarding.meta.templates[wabaId] = []);
      if (parts[2] === 'message_templates' && data.method === 'POST') {
        const body = typeof data.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(data.body) : {};
        if ((onboarding.meta.refuseTemplateNames ?? []).includes(body.name)) return json(res, 400, { error: { code: 100, type: 'OAuthException', message: 'fixture refusal' } });
        if (templates.some((item) => item.name === body.name && item.language === body.language)) return json(res, 400, { error: { code: 100 } });
        const created = { ...body, id: `fixture-template-${templates.length + 1}`, status: onboarding.meta.templateStatus ?? 'PENDING' };
        templates.push(created);
        if (onboarding.holdsAfter[templateOperation] || onboarding.ambiguousAfter[templateOperation]) {
          await providerEffect(templateOperation, { wabaId, name: body.name });
        }
        return json(res, 200, { id: created.id });
      }
      if (parts[2] === 'message_templates') {
        let rows = templates;
        const name = graphUrl.searchParams.get('name'); if (name) rows = rows.filter((item) => item.name === name);
        const offset = Number(graphUrl.searchParams.get('after') ?? 0);
        const limit = Math.min(50, Number(graphUrl.searchParams.get('limit') ?? 25));
        const page = rows.slice(offset, offset + limit).map((item) => onboarding.meta.catalogStatusOverride
          ? { ...item, status: onboarding.meta.catalogStatusOverride } : item);
        const next = offset + limit < rows.length ? String(offset + limit) : null;
        return json(res, 200, { data: page, ...(onboarding.meta.contradictoryTemplateList ? { error: { code: 1, message: 'controlled contradictory response' } } : {}),
          ...(next ? { paging: { cursors: { after: next }, next: `https://graph.facebook.com/${parts[0]}/${wabaId}/message_templates?after=${next}` } } : {}) });
      }
      const allowedWabas = new Set(resources.map((item) => item.wabaId));
      const item = [...allowedWabas].flatMap((allowedWaba) => onboarding.meta.templates[allowedWaba] ?? [])
        .find((candidate) => candidate.id === parts[1]);
      if (item && onboarding.meta.templateStatusAfterGet) item.status = onboarding.meta.templateStatusAfterGet;
      return item ? json(res, 200, onboarding.meta.contradictoryTemplateGet ? { ...item, error: { code: 1, message: 'controlled contradictory response' } } : item)
        : json(res, 404, { error: { code: 100 } });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/release') {
      const b = barriers.get(`${data.operation}:${data.key}`); if (b) b.release();
      return json(res, 200, { released: Boolean(b) });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/call') {
      const call = await providerCall(String(data.operation), data.args ?? {});
      return json(res, 200, { accepted: true, call });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/effect') return json(res, 200, { effect: await providerEffect(String(data.operation), data.args ?? {}) });
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/initial-attempt/expire') {
      const attemptId = typeof data.attemptId === 'string' ? data.attemptId : '';
      const buId = typeof data.buId === 'string' ? data.buId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(attemptId)
        || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid attempt scope' });
      const current = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: attemptId, buId, slotReleasedAt: null } });
      if (!current || !['AMBIGUOUS', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', 'PREPARED'].includes(current.state)) return json(res, 404, { error: 'eligible fixture attempt not found' });
      const changed = await prisma.initialMessageIntent.updateMany({
        where: { id: attemptId, buId, state: current.state, slotReleasedAt: null },
        data: current.state === 'PREPARED'
          ? { leaseExpiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) }
          : { dispatchDeadlineAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) },
      });
      if (changed.count !== 1) return json(res, 404, { error: 'eligible fixture attempt not found' });
      return json(res, 200, { expired: true, attemptId, buId });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/initial-attempt/prepare') {
      const conversationId = typeof data.conversationId === 'string' ? data.conversationId : '';
      const buId = typeof data.buId === 'string' ? data.buId : '';
      const actorId = typeof data.actorId === 'string' ? data.actorId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(conversationId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(actorId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid initial reservation scope' });
      const [conversation, channel, role] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.conversation.findFirst({ where: { id: conversationId, buId } }),
        prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { buId, type: 'OFICIAL' }, include: { credential: true } }),
        prisma.userBuRole.findFirst({ where: { userId: actorId, buId } }),
      ]);
      if (!conversation || !channel || !role?.role) return json(res, 404, { error: 'initial reservation scope not found' });
      const identity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirst({ where: { currentChannelId: channel.id, buId, provider: 'OFICIAL' } });
      if (!identity || !channel.credential) return json(res, 409, { error: 'verified fixture channel required' });
      const ownerNonce = randomUUID();
      const idempotencyKey = randomUUID();
      const messageText = 'synthetic prepared recovery probe';
      const selectedContext = {
        channelId: channel.id, buId, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id,
        generation: channel.generation, pairingEpoch: channel.pairingEpoch,
        activeCredentialVersion: channel.credential.version, requiresWindow: channel.requiresWindow,
        providerAccountReference: channel.wabaId ? createHash('sha256').update(`meta-waba\0${channel.wabaId}`).digest('hex') : null,
      };
      const canonicalRequest = {
        channelId: channel.id, expectedGeneration: channel.generation, kind: 'text', text: messageText,
        previewFingerprint: createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJson({
          version: 'initial-preview-v1', context: selectedContext, recipient: conversation.contact,
          semantics: { kind: 'text', text: messageText },
        })).digest('hex'),
        recipient: conversation.contact,
      };
      const request = {
        canonicalRequest,
        originalConversation: { updatedAt: conversation.updatedAt.toISOString(), status: conversation.status,
          attendantUserId: conversation.attendantUserId, attendantName: conversation.attendantName, attendantOrigin: conversation.attendantOrigin },
        renderedText: messageText,
        originalActorName: (await prisma.appUser.findUnique({ where: { id: actorId }, select: { name: true } }))?.name ?? 'Fixture operator',
      };
      const reservation = await new DispatchAdmissionService(prisma).reserveInitial({
        conversationId, buId, contact: conversation.contact, actorId, idempotencyKey, ownerNonce,
        selectedContext, requestFingerprint: createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJson(canonicalRequest)).digest('hex'), request,
      });
      if (!reservation.created || reservation.intent.state !== 'PREPARED' || reservation.intent.leaseExpiresAt.getTime() > Date.now() + 90_000) {
        return json(res, 500, { error: 'canonical prepared reservation was not created' });
      }
      return json(res, 201, { attemptId: reservation.intent.id, state: reservation.intent.state });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/channel/generation') {
      const channelId = typeof data.channelId === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(data.channelId) ? data.channelId : '';
      if (!channelId) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid fixture channel scope' });
      const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findUnique({ where: { id: channelId }, include: { credential: true } });
      if (!channel?.credential || channel.type !== 'OFICIAL') return json(res, 404, { changed: false });
      const generation = channel.generation + 1;
      const version = channel.credential.version + 1;
      const keyId = process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID;
      const key = Buffer.from(process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY, 'base64');
      const envelope = sealChannelCredential(`timeline-scoped-token:${channel.phoneNumberId}`, keyId, key, {
        purpose: 'active', provider: 'OFICIAL', buId: channel.buId, channelId: channel.id, generation, version,
      });
      await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.buChannel.update({ where: { id: channelId }, data: { generation } });
        await tx.channelCredential.update({ where: { channelId }, data: {
          generation, version, keyId, nonce: new Uint8Array(envelope.nonce),
          ciphertext: new Uint8Array(envelope.ciphertext), tag: new Uint8Array(envelope.tag),
        } });
      });
      return json(res, 200, { changed: true, generation });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/evolution/observe') {
      await providerCall('evolution.observe', { name: data.name });
      const name = String(data.name); const observed = onboarding.evolution.inventory[name];
      return json(res, 200, observed ? { ...observed } : null);
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/evolution/create') {
      const call = await providerCall('evolution.create', { name: data.name, attemptId: data.attemptId, channelId: data.channelId, generation: data.generation, pairingEpoch: data.pairingEpoch });
      const created = onboarding.evolution.createOutcome ?? {};
      const instance = { name: String(data.name), ownerJid: data.ownerJid ?? created.ownerJid ?? null, connectionStatus: data.connectionStatus ?? created.connectionStatus ?? 'connecting', qrcode: data.qrcode ?? created.qrcode ?? 'data:image/png;base64,FAKE-QR' };
      onboarding.evolution.inventory[instance.name] = instance;
      await providerEffect('evolution.create', { name: instance.name, attemptId: data.attemptId, channelId: data.channelId, generation: data.generation, pairingEpoch: data.pairingEpoch });
      return json(res, 201, { created: true, instance, call });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/evolution/delete') {
      await providerCall('evolution.delete', { name: data.name });
      const existed = Boolean(onboarding.evolution.inventory[String(data.name)]);
      delete onboarding.evolution.inventory[String(data.name)];
      await providerEffect('evolution.delete', { name: data.name });
      return json(res, 200, { deleted: existed });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/evolution/receipt') {
      const name = String(data.name); const observed = onboarding.evolution.inventory[name];
      if (!observed) return json(res, 404, { error: 'unknown fixture instance' });
      Object.assign(observed, { ownerJid: data.ownerJid ?? observed.ownerJid, connectionStatus: data.connectionStatus ?? observed.connectionStatus });
      await providerEffect('evolution.receipt', { name });
      return json(res, 200, { updated: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/attempt/expire') {
      const attemptId = typeof data.attemptId === 'string' ? data.attemptId : '';
      const buId = typeof data.buId === 'string' ? data.buId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/i.test(attemptId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid attempt scope' });
      const changed = await prisma.channelRegistrationAttempt.updateMany({
        where: { id: attemptId, buId, operation: 'NOVO', state: 'PENDING_AUTH', channelId: { not: null } },
        data: { expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000) },
      });
      if (changed.count !== 1) return json(res, 404, { error: 'eligible fixture attempt not found' });
      return json(res, 200, { expired: true, attemptId, buId });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/seed-number-onboarding') {
      const result = await seedNumberOnboarding(data);
      return json(res, 201, result);
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url.startsWith('/audit?')) {
      const query = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost').searchParams;
      const conversationId = query.get('conversationId');
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: conversationId } });
      const messages = await prisma.message.findMany({ where: { conversationId }, orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }], select: { id: true, content: true, direction: true, authorName: true, createdAt: true, externalId: true } });
      return json(res, 200, { status: conversation.status, unreadCount: conversation.unreadCount, messages });
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url.startsWith('/audit-outbound?')) {
      const query = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost').searchParams;
      const conversationId = query.get('conversationId');
      const content = query.get('content');
      if (!conversationId || !fixtureConversationIds.has(conversationId) || !content) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid fixture audit scope' });
      const messages = await prisma.message.findMany({ where: { conversationId, content, direction: 'OUT' }, select: { status: true, externalId: true } });
      return json(res, 200, {
        total: messages.length,
        accepted: messages.filter((message) => message.status === 'ENVIADA').length,
        failed: messages.filter((message) => message.status === 'FALHOU').length,
        failedWithoutExternalId: messages.filter((message) => message.status === 'FALHOU' && !message.externalId).length,
      });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/seed') return json(res, 201, await seed(data));
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/send-mode') {
      if (!['accepted', 'unknown'].includes(data.mode)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid mode' });
      onboarding.meta.sendMode = data.mode;
      return json(res, 200, { mode: onboarding.meta.sendMode });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/select-evolution') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const channel = await prisma.buChannel.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { buId: conversation.buId, type: 'NAO_OFICIAL' } });
      const identity = await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { currentChannelId: channel.id } });
      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: 'ingress fixture selects Evolution', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        externalId: `fixture-ingress-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`,
        providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, createdAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
      } });
      return json(res, 201, { id: message.id });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/incoming') return json(res, 200, await incoming(data));
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/late-tie') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const message = await prisma.message.create({ data: {
        id: String(data.id), conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId,
        direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO', content: 'inserção empatada tardia',
        channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA', createdAt: new Date(data.createdAt),
      } });
      return json(res, 201, { id: message.id });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/revoke') {
      await prisma.userBuRole.deleteMany({ where: { userId: data.userId, buId: data.businessUnitId } });
      return json(res, 200, { revoked: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/restore-fixture-grant') {
      const userId = typeof data.userId === 'string' ? data.userId : '';
      const buId = typeof data.businessUnitId === 'string' ? data.businessUnitId : '';
      if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(userId) || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(buId)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid fixture grant scope' });
      await prisma.userBuRole.upsert({ where: { userId_buId: { userId, buId } },
        create: { userId, buId, role: 'OWNER', grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' }, update: { role: 'OWNER', grantedViaTipo: 'DIRETO' } });
      return json(res, 200, { restored: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/burst') {
      const conversation = await prisma.conversation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: data.conversationId } });
      const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(data.count ?? 120), 500));
      const base = new Date(data.createdAt ?? Date.now());
      await prisma.message.createMany({ data: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: `burst ${i + 1}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        createdAt: new Date(base.getTime() + i),
      })) });
      return json(res, 201, { count });
    }
    return json(res, 404, { error: 'not found' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return json(res, 500, { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
  }
});
server.listen(fixturePort, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log(`timeline fixtures listening on 127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}`));
process.on('SIGTERM', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));
process.on('SIGINT', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));

  process.env.EVOLUTION_API_KEY = 'timeline-provider-port-only';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET = 'timeline-evolution-header-secret';
  process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:3100/webhooks/evolution';
  process.env.CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID = 'timeline-key-v1';

  let fixturePrisma;
  const fixture = async (path, method = 'GET', body) => {

  };
  const nativeFetch = global.fetch.bind(global);
  global.fetch = async (input, init = {}) => {
    const url = String(input);

    return nativeFetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}/provider/meta/request`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-fixture-provider-token': 'timeline-provider-port-only' },

  const call = (operation, args = {}) => fixture('/provider/call', 'POST', { operation, args });
  const tokenPermitido = async (accessToken) => {
    return /^timeline-code-token:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(accessToken ?? '');
  };
  const providerResources = async (accessToken) => {
    if (!/^timeline-(?:scoped-token|code-token):[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(accessToken ?? '')) throw new Error('scoped credential required');
    if (accessToken.startsWith('timeline-scoped-token:')) {

      const exact = await fixture(`/provider/resources?phoneNumberId=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);

      const ids = state.meta.grantResourceIds?.[code]; if (!Array.isArray(ids)) throw new Error('unknown fixture grant');
      all = all.filter((r) => ids.includes(r.id));

  const metaFake = {

''); const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); if (!Object.hasOwn(state.meta.grantResourceIds ?? {}, safeCode)) throw new Error('unknown fixture authorization grant'); return { accessToken: `timeline-code-token:${Buffer.from(safeCode).toString('base64url')}` }; },
    async recursos(accessToken, wabaId, after) {

      await call('meta.confirm', { wabaId, phoneNumberId, after: after ?? null });

      }
      if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required');
      const resources = await providerResources(accessToken);
      const authorized = resources.some((r) => r.id === phoneNumberId && r.wabaId === wabaId);
      if (!authorized) return null;
      await call('meta.confirm', { wabaId, phoneNumberId, after: null });
      const seen = new Set(); let after = null;
      for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {

        const number = page.data.find((item) => item.id === phoneNumberId);
        if (number) return number;
        if (!page.next) return null;
        if (page.next.length > 512 || seen.has(page.next) || index === 1) throw new MetaIndisponivelError('A verificação do número está inconclusiva.');

    async inscreverWaba(id, accessToken) { if (!(await tokenPermitido(accessToken))) throw new Error('scoped credential required'); await call('meta.subscribe', { wabaId: id }); await fixture('/provider/effect', 'POST', { operation: 'meta.subscribe', args: { wabaId: id } }); },

    },

  };
  const evolutionInventory = new Map();
  const evolutionFake = {
    configurado: () => true,
    async criarInstancia(name) {
      const channel = await fixturePrisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { evolutionInstanceName: name }, select: { id: true, buId: true, generation: true, pairingEpoch: true, currentAttemptId: true } });
      const result = await fixture('/provider/evolution/create', 'POST', { name, channelId: channel?.id, attemptId: channel?.currentAttemptId, generation: channel?.generation, pairingEpoch: channel?.pairingEpoch });
      evolutionInventory.set(name, result.instance); return { qrcode: result.instance.qrcode };
    },
    async qrDaInstancia(name) { await call('evolution.qr', { name }); const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.qrcode ?? null; },
    async estadoDaInstancia(name) { const observed = await fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); return observed?.connectionStatus ?? 'close'; },
    async consultarInstancia(name) { return fixture('/provider/evolution/observe', 'POST', { name }); },
    async apagarInstancia(name) { await fixture('/provider/evolution/delete', 'POST', { name }); evolutionInventory.delete(name); },

      const state = await fixture('/provider/state'); await call('evolution.send', { name });

        const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}/webhooks/evolution`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-leadshug-webhook-secret': process.env.EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('authenticated fixture webhook rejected');
      }
      return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: id };
    },

  const moduleRef = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
    .overrideProvider(META_CLIENT).useValue(metaFake)
    .overrideProvider(EVOLUTION_CLIENT).useValue(evolutionFake)
