```typescript
  fixturePrisma = moduleRef.get(PrismaService);
  const app = moduleRef.createNestApplication({ bodyParser: false });
  configurarBodyParsers(app);
  app.enableCors({ origin: ['http://127.0.0.1:4173'], credentials: true });
  await app.init();
  app.get(RealtimeService).ligar(app.getHttpServer());
  await app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT ?? '3100'), '0.0.0.0');
  const close = async () => { await app.get(PrismaService).$disconnect(); await app.close(); };
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  process.on('SIGINT', () => void close().finally(() => process.exit(0)));
  console.log(`timeline test API listening on ${process.env.PORT ?? '3100'}; database ${dbName}`);
}

main().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { renderInitialTemplate } from './initial-message-template-renderer';
import type { TemplateSummary } from '../message-templates/template-management.ports';

function summary(parameterFormat: TemplateSummary['parameterFormat'], body: string): TemplateSummary {
  return {
    remoteTemplateId: 'remote-1', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'hello_customer', language: 'pt_BR',
    category: 'UTILITY', parameterFormat, components: [{
      type: 'BODY', text: body,
      parameters: [...body.matchAll(/\{\{([^{}]+)\}\}/g)].map((match) => match[1]),
    }],
    // These ST-05 authoring flags deliberately do not authorize or reject initial rendering.
    supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null,
  };
}

describe('initial message template renderer', () => {
  it('renders a NAMED body from sanitized catalog components despite authoring flags', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', 'Oi {{first_name}}, pedido {{order_id}} chegou.'), {
      first_name: 'Ana', order_id: '42',
    });
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('Oi Ana, pedido 42 chegou.');
    expect(rendered.semanticFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  });

  it('renders POSITIONAL values in component occurrence order without trusting the null catalog fingerprint', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', 'Oi {{1}}, seu pedido {{2}} está pronto, {{1}}.'), ['Ana', '42']);
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('Oi Ana, seu pedido 42 está pronto, Ana.');
    expect(rendered.semanticFingerprint).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
  });

  it('maps POSITIONAL values numerically when the first BODY occurrence is out of order and repeats a key', () => {
    const rendered = renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', '{{2}} then {{1}} and again {{2}}'), ['Ana', '42']);
    expect(rendered.text).toBe('42 then Ana and again 42');
  });

  it('rejects gaps, missing or extra values, and non-static header/footer placeholders', () => {
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('POSITIONAL', 'Oi {{2}}'), ['Ana', '42'])).toThrow();
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', 'Oi {{first_name}}'), {})).toThrow();
    const withHeader = { ...summary('NAMED', 'Oi'), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: '{{name}}', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'Oi', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(withHeader, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('rejects a blank BODY even when a static header makes the snapshot nonempty', () => {
    const blankBody = { ...summary('NAMED', ''), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'Hello', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: '', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(blankBody, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('renders components in HEADER/BODY/FOOTER order even when sanitized catalog order differs', () => {
    const reordered = { ...summary('NAMED', 'Body'), components: [
      { type: 'FOOTER' as const, text: 'Footer', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'Body', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'Header', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(reordered, {}).text).toBe('Header\nBody\nFooter');
  });

  it('enforces the rendered snapshot boundary including static header and footer', () => {
    const atLimit = { ...summary('NAMED', 'x'.repeat(4092)), components: [
      { type: 'HEADER' as const, format: 'TEXT' as const, text: 'H', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'x'.repeat(4092), parameters: [] },
      { type: 'FOOTER' as const, text: 'F', parameters: [] },
    ] };
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(atLimit, {}).text).toHaveLength(4096);
    const overLimit = { ...atLimit, components: [
      atLimit.components[0]!,
      { type: 'BODY' as const, text: 'x'.repeat(4093), parameters: [] },
      atLimit.components[2]!,
    ] };
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(overLimit, {})).toThrow();
  });

  it('counts Unicode code points for the per-value limit', () => {
    const template = summary('NAMED', '{{value}}');
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(template, { value: '😀'.repeat(1024) }).text).toBe('😀'.repeat(1024));
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(template, { value: '😀'.repeat(1025) })).toThrow();
  });

  it('allows at most twenty distinct parameters and rejects extras', () => {
    const keys = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => `p${index + 1}`);
    const values = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, 'v']));
    expect(renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', keys.map((key) => `{{${key}}}`).join(' ')), values).text)
      .toBe(keys.map(() => 'v').join(' '));
    const twentyOne = [...keys, 'p21'];
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', twentyOne.map((key) => `{{${key}}}`).join(' ')),
      Object.fromEntries(twentyOne.map((key) => [key, 'v'])))).toThrow();
    expect(() => renderInitialTemplate(summary('NAMED', '{{p1}}'), { p1: 'v', extra: 'x' })).toThrow();
  });
});
```

### api-app/src/domain/inbox/channel-window-policy.spec.ts

SHA256 `e20eaefd11256c8ca9f2156560ac23a1478f333b3932e865d1d52666cbd78692`. not in inherited dirty-file seal; current exact source supplied, not inferred as newly added.

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { isOfficialWindowOpen, qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp } from './channel-window-policy';

const now = new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00.000Z');
const DAY_SECONDS = 24 * 60 * 60;

describe('qualified official window policy', () => {
  it('accepts only positive integer signed Meta timestamps no later than now', () => {
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(String(Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1000)), now)).toEqual(now);
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('0', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('12.5', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp('not-a-time', now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(String(Math.floor(now.getTime() / 1000) + 1), now)).toBeNull();
    expect(qualifiedMetaInboundTimestamp(null, now)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('uses only the selected managed resource’s trusted Meta IN and a strict 24-hour boundary', () => {
    const selected = 'resource-current';
    const trustedAt = new Date(now.getTime() - (DAY_SECONDS - 1) * 1000);
    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: trustedAt },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-old', officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'OUT', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: now },
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected, officialInboundAt: null, createdAt: now },
    ], selected, now)).toBe(true);

    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([
      { direction: 'IN', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: selected,
        officialInboundAt: new Date(now.getTime() - DAY_SECONDS * 1000), createdAt: now },
    ], selected, now)).toBe(false);
    expect(isOfficialWindowOpen([], selected, now)).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { InitialMessageService } from './initial-message.service';

const attempt = {
  id: 'attempt-1', conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1',
  idempotencyKey: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', requestFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint',
  request: { canonicalRequest: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint', recipient: '5511987654321' } },
  ownerNonce: 'stored-owner', state: 'SUCCEEDED', externalMessageId: 'provider-message-1', slotReleasedAt: new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00Z'),
};

function makeService(replayAttempt = attempt) {
  const events: string[] = [];
  const prisma = {
    $transaction: vi.fn(async (callback: (tx: unknown) => Promise<boolean>) => { events.push('current-grant'); return callback({}); }),
    conversation: { findFirst: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('conversation-read'); return {
      id: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', contact: '5511987654321', contactType: 'PESSOA',
      status: 'QUEUED', attendantUserId: null, updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-22T12:00:00Z'),
    }; }) },
  };
  const outbound = {
    prepareInitial: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('channel-bind'); return { channel: {}, context: {
      channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1',
      generation: 1, pairingEpoch: 1, activeCredentialVersion: 2, requiresWindow: true,
      providerAccountReference: 'account-ref',
    } }; }),
    sendInitial: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('dispatch'); return { id: 'message-1' }; }),
  };
  const admissions = {
    findInitialReplay: vi.fn(async () => { events.push('idempotency-lookup'); return { intent: replayAttempt, ownerNonce: 'new-request-owner' }; }),
    reserveInitial: vi.fn(),
  };
  const templates = { resolve: vi.fn() };
  const observations = { getCatalog: vi.fn() };
  return {
    service: new InitialMessageService(prisma as never, outbound as never, admissions as never, templates as never, observations as never),
    events, prisma, outbound, admissions, templates, observations,
  };
}

describe('InitialMessageService', () => {
  it('resolves a terminal idempotent replay before channel binding or any provider-facing dispatch', async () => {
    const { service, events, outbound, admissions, templates, observations } = makeService();
    const result = await service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ replay: true, attempt: { id: attempt.id, state: attempt.state, externalAccepted: true } });
    expect(result).not.toHaveProperty('ownerNonce');
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(outbound.sendInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(templates.resolve).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(observations.getCatalog).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(admissions.reserveInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns an uncertainty conflict for an ambiguous replay without provider reads or a new send', async () => {
    const ambiguous = { ...attempt, state: 'AMBIGUOUS', externalMessageId: null };
    const { service, events, outbound } = makeService(ambiguous);
    await expect(service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Hello', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: attempt.id, state: 'AMBIGUOUS' } });
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(outbound.sendInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects a changed canonical request that reuses the same preview fingerprint before channel binding', async () => {
    const { service, events, outbound, admissions } = makeService();
    await expect(service.submit({
      conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', actorName: 'Ada',
      idempotencyKey: attempt.idempotencyKey,
      message: { channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'text', text: 'Changed body', previewFingerprint: 'preview-fingerprint' },
      validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED' } });
    expect(events).toEqual(['current-grant', 'conversation-read', 'idempotency-lookup']);
    expect(admissions.findInitialReplay).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(outbound.prepareInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('maps unsupported catalog components to a safe preview conflict before reservation or dispatch', async () => {
    const { service, outbound, admissions, templates, observations } = makeService();
    const context = {
      channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', providerResourceIdentityId: 'resource-1', generation: 1,
      pairingEpoch: 1, activeCredentialVersion: 2, requiresWindow: true, providerAccountReference: 'account-ref',
      channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL',
    };
    templates.resolve.mockResolvedValue({ context: { ...context, accountReference: 'account-ref' } });
    observations.getCatalog.mockResolvedValue({ available: true, items: [{
      remoteTemplateId: 'unsupported', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'unsupported', language: 'en_US', category: 'UTILITY',
      parameterFormat: 'NAMED', components: [{ type: 'UNKNOWN', providerType: 'OTHER' }], supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null,
    }] });

    await expect(service.preview({ conversationId: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', actorId: 'actor-1', message: {
      channelId: 'channel-1', expectedGeneration: 1, kind: 'approved-template', remoteTemplateId: 'unsupported', language: 'en_US',
      catalogAfter: null, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64), values: {},
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { ChannelOperationContext, ChannelSendResult } from '../channels/transport/channel';
import { OutboundService } from './outbound.service';

const context: ChannelOperationContext = Object.freeze({
  channelId: 'channel-1', buId: 'bu-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', providerResourceIdentityId: 'identity-1',
  generation: 1, pairingEpoch: 2, activeCredentialVersion: 3, requiresWindow: false, providerAccountReference: null,
});
const conversation = { id: 'conversation-1', buId: 'bu-1', contact: 'user:opaque', contactType: 'PESSOA' as const };

function setup(result: ChannelSendResult) {
  const channel = { sendMessage: vi.fn(async (
    _message: unknown,
    options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> },
  ) => {
    if (result.outcome === 'BLOCKED') return result;
    if (options?.beforeDispatch && !await options.beforeDispatch()) {
      return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' } as const;
    }
    return result;
  }) };
  const resolver = {
    resolveForConversation: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ channel, context }),
    resolveForInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ channel, context }),
    validateOperationContextInTransaction: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    contextAfterDispatch: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('CURRENT'),
  };
  const acceptance = {
    recordAmbiguousOutbound: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'diagnostic-1' }),
    accept: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      message: { id: 'message-1', channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL' }, creationWinner: false,
    }),
  };
  const prisma = {
    conversation: { findFirst: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(conversation) },
    message: { findUnique: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(null) },
    $transaction: vi.fn(),
  };
  const realtime = { publicarNaBu: vi.fn() };
  const windows = { inspect: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ open: true, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000) }) };
  const admissions = {
    reserveOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ admission: { id: 'admission-1' }, ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce' }),
    claimOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    settleOrdinary: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    releasePrepared: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    claimInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    rejectInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    rejectPreparedInitial: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    markInitialAmbiguous: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
    markInitialLocalBlocked: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
  };
  const service = Reflect.construct(OutboundService, [prisma, resolver, acceptance, realtime, windows, admissions]) as OutboundService;
  return { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma, channel, windows, admissions };
}

function input() {
  return { conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, text: 'hello', attribution: { kind: 'BFF' as const, userId: 'user-1', name: 'Agent' } };
}

describe('OutboundService error projection', () => {
  it.each([
    ['BU', { buId: 'bu-other' }],
    ['channel', { channelId: 'channel-other' }],
    ['origin', { channelOrigin: 'NAO_OFICIAL' }],
    ['resource', { providerResourceIdentityId: 'identity-other' }],
    ['generation', { generation: 99 }],
    ['pairing epoch', { pairingEpoch: 99 }],
    ['credential version', { activeCredentialVersion: 99 }],
    ['window policy', { requiresWindow: true }],
    ['account reference', { providerAccountReference: 'meta:waba-other' }],
  ] as Array<[string, Partial<ChannelOperationContext>]>)('rejects initial dispatch before claim when captured %s differs from current context', async (_field, delta) => {
    const candidate = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'must-not-send' });
    const currentContext = { ...context, ...delta } as ChannelOperationContext;
    candidate.resolver.resolveForInitial.mockResolvedValue({ channel: candidate.channel, context: currentContext });

    await expect(candidate.service.sendInitial({
      conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, channelId: context.channelId, kind: 'text',
      intent: { id: 'intent-context-mismatch' } as never, ownerNonce: 'owner-context-mismatch',
      operation: { channel: candidate.channel as never, context },
      payload: { kind: 'text', recipientRef: '5511987654321', text: 'must not dispatch' }, request: {},
      originalConversation: { updatedAt: new Date(), status: 'QUEUED', attendantUserId: null, attendantName: null, attendantOrigin: null },
      actorId: 'user-1', actorName: 'Agent', validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'BLOCKED' } });

    expect(candidate.channel.sendMessage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(candidate.admissions.claimInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(candidate.acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(candidate.admissions.rejectPreparedInitial).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it('keeps the initial slot when claim commit/readback is unknown and prevents provider POST', async () => {
    const blocked = setup({ outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' });
    const sends = blocked.channel.sendMessage;
    let providerPostCount = 0;
    sends.mockImplementation(async (_message: unknown, options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> }) => {
      try {
        if (options?.beforeDispatch && await options.beforeDispatch()) providerPostCount += 1;
      } catch { /* claim uncertainty is a closed fence */ }
      return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
    });
    blocked.resolver.resolveForInitial.mockResolvedValue({ channel: blocked.channel, context });
    blocked.admissions.claimInitial = vi.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('claim readback unavailable'));
    blocked.admissions.rejectInitial = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);
    blocked.admissions.rejectPreparedInitial = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(false);
    blocked.admissions.markInitialAmbiguous = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(true);

    await expect(blocked.service.sendInitial({
      conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, channelId: context.channelId, kind: 'text',
      intent: { id: 'intent-1' } as never, ownerNonce: 'owner-1', operation: { channel: blocked.channel as never, context },
      payload: { kind: 'text', recipientRef: '5511987654321', text: 'Hello' }, request: {},
      originalConversation: { updatedAt: new Date(), status: 'QUEUED', attendantUserId: null, attendantName: null, attendantOrigin: null },
      actorId: 'user-1', actorName: 'Agent', validateActorInTransaction: async () => true,
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' } });
    expect(providerPostCount).toBe(0);
    expect(blocked.admissions.rejectInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(blocked.admissions.rejectPreparedInitial).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(blocked.admissions.markInitialAmbiguous).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reserves an ordinary owner before preflight and claims it only at the final provider boundary', async () => {
    const { service, channel, admissions } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    const trace: string[] = [];
    channel.sendMessage.mockImplementation(async (_message: unknown, options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> }) => {
      trace.push('preflight');
      if (!options?.beforeDispatch) {
        trace.push('unfenced-post');
        return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' };
      }
      if (!await options.beforeDispatch()) return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
      trace.push('post');
      return { outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' };
    });
    admissions.reserveOrdinary.mockImplementation(async (input) => {
      trace.push('reserve');
      expect(input).toMatchObject({
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, caller: 'BFF', actorId: 'user-1',
        selectedContext: context,
      });
      return { admission: { id: 'admission-1' }, ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce' };
    });
    admissions.claimOrdinary.mockImplementation(async (input) => {
      trace.push('claim');
      expect(input).toMatchObject({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce' });
      return true;

    expect(admissions.settleOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce', state: 'SETTLED' });
  });

  it('reserves and releases an unclaimed owner when preflight blocks before the provider fence', async () => {
    const blocked = setup({ outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' });

    expect(blocked.admissions.claimOrdinary).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(blocked.admissions.releasePrepared).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce' });
    expect(blocked.admissions.settleOrdinary).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('retains an uncertain claimed send instead of releasing it', async () => {
    const uncertain = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' });
    uncertain.channel.sendMessage.mockImplementation(async (_message: unknown, options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> }) => {
      if (options?.beforeDispatch && !await options.beforeDispatch()) return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
      return { outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' };
    });

    expect(uncertain.admissions.reserveOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(uncertain.admissions.claimOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(uncertain.admissions.settleOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce', state: 'UNCERTAIN' });
    expect(uncertain.admissions.releasePrepared).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('settles a confirmed provider refusal after the owner claim', async () => {
    const refused = setup({ outcome: 'REJECTED', code: 'PROVIDER_REFUSED' });
    refused.channel.sendMessage.mockImplementation(async (_message: unknown, options?: { beforeDispatch?: () => Promise<boolean> }) => {
      if (options?.beforeDispatch && !await options.beforeDispatch()) return { outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED' };
      return { outcome: 'REJECTED', code: 'PROVIDER_REFUSED' };
    });
    await expect(refused.service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 400 });
    expect(refused.admissions.reserveOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(refused.admissions.claimOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(refused.admissions.settleOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce', state: 'SETTLED' });
    expect(refused.admissions.releasePrepared).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('records one diagnostic only for a valid ACK without external ID', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, channel } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' });
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID_MISSING', outcome: 'AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED', diagnosticPersistence: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(channel.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps malformed or failed transport unknown without writing a diagnostic', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, channel } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' });
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 400, response: { code: 'META_RECUSOU', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(channel.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('gives a detected post-dispatch identity change precedence before null-ID diagnostics', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'META_RECUSOU' });
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CHANGED');
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns UNKNOWN/503 when the diagnostic commit is uncertain and context remains current', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, resolver } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'SEND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture commit uncertain'));
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(resolver.contextAfterDispatch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('gives a detected context retirement during diagnostic persistence precedence with no external-id write', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'SEND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound.mockImplementation(async () => {
      resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CHANGED');
      throw new Error('identity fence rejected diagnostic transaction');
    });
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports a confirmed diagnostic write as RECORDED if the identity retires immediately afterward', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance } = setup({ outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', legacyCode: 'SEND_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE' });
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValueOnce('CURRENT').mockResolvedValueOnce('CHANGED');
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'UNKNOWN', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', diagnosticPersistence: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.recordAmbiguousOutbound).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not start Message acceptance when the identity changed after an acknowledged send', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CHANGED');
    prisma.message.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports uncertainty before local Message acceptance as UNCONFIRMED', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    acceptance.accept.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture transaction did not confirm'));
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValue('CURRENT');
    prisma.message.findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED' },
    });
  });

  it('reports a confirmed Message commit as RECORDED after a later local finalization failure', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    prisma.$transaction.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture conversation finalization failure'));
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not report complete ordinary success when the durable settlement is explicitly unconfirmed', async () => {
    const { service, acceptance, admissions, channel } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    admissions.settleOrdinary.mockResolvedValue(false);
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503, response: { code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(channel.sendMessage).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(admissions.settleOrdinary).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'admission-1', ownerNonce: 'captured-nonce', state: 'SETTLED' });
  });

  it('keeps a known committed Message RECORDED and returns context-changed after a local finalization failure', async () => {
    const { service, resolver, acceptance, prisma } = setup({ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', externalMessageId: 'external-1' });
    prisma.$transaction.mockRejectedValue(new Error('fixture finalization failure'));
    resolver.contextAfterDispatch.mockResolvedValueOnce('CURRENT').mockResolvedValueOnce('CHANGED');
    await expect(service.send(input())).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 409, response: { code: 'CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', localMessageState: 'RECORDED' },
    });
    expect(acceptance.accept).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

```typescript
  const rules: Array<[string, RegExp]> = [
    ['concrete provider or adapter import', /from\s+['"][^'"]*integrations\/(?:meta|evolution|channels)\/[^'"]+['"]/],
    ['provider credential resolver import', /from\s+['"][^'"]*channel-credential-resolver['"]/],
    ['direct HTTP client usage', /\bfetch\s*\(|\baxios(?:\s*\(|\.(?:get|post|put|delete|request)\s*\()/],
    ['provider client type or token', /\b(?:MetaHttpClient|MetaClient|EvolutionClient|EVOLUTION_CLIENT|META_CLIENT)\b/],
  ];
  return rules.filter(([, expression]) => expression.test(source)).map(([name]) => name);
}
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { MetaClient } from './meta.client';
import { metaAccountReference } from '../channels/account-reference';
import { MetaInitialMessageClient } from './initial-message.client';

describe('MetaInitialMessageClient positional template wire', () => {
  it('orders unique positional values numerically, independent of placeholder order and repetition', () => {
    const client = new MetaInitialMessageClient({} as never);
    const summary = {
      remoteTemplateId: 'tpl-1', name: 'ordered', language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
      parameterFormat: 'POSITIONAL', status: 'APPROVED', supported: true,
      components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: '{{2}} antes {{1}} e {{2}}', parameters: ['2', '1', '2'] }],
    } as never;
    const render = Reflect.get(client, 'templateWire') as (summary: unknown, values: readonly string[]) => unknown;
    expect(render.call(client, summary, ['primeiro', 'segundo'])).toEqual({
      name: 'ordered', language: { code: 'pt_BR' },
      components: [{ type: 'body', parameters: [{ type: 'text', text: 'primeiro' }, { type: 'text', text: 'segundo' }] }],
    });
  });

  it('does not claim or POST when bounded membership verification exhausts the total 75-second budget', async () => {
    const start = Date.now();
    let now = start;
    vi.spyOn(Date, 'now').mockImplementation(() => now);
    vi.stubEnv('GRAPH_VERSION', 'v26.0');
    const verify = vi.fn(async () => {
      now = start + 75_000;
      return { id: 'phone-fixture', telefone: '+5511999999999', nomeVerificado: 'Fixture' };
    });
    const beforeDispatch = vi.fn(async () => true);
    const fetch = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetch);
    try {
      const client = new MetaInitialMessageClient({ verificarNumeroVinculado: verify } as unknown as MetaClient);
      const result = await client.sendInitialMessage({
        wabaId: 'account-fixture', phoneNumberId: 'phone-fixture', recipientE164: '+5511999999999',
        accessToken: 'scoped-fixture-token', accountReference: metaAccountReference('account-fixture'),
        payload: { kind: 'text', recipientRef: 'contact-fixture', text: 'bounded request' }, beforeDispatch,
      });
      expect(result).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'BLOCKED', reason: 'CHANNEL_NOT_READY' });
      expect(verify).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(beforeDispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(fetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally {
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
      vi.unstubAllEnvs();
    }
  });
});

describe('MetaInitialMessageClient acknowledgement classification', () => {
  it.each([
    ['malformed receipt id', 200, { messages: [{ id: 17 }] }],
    ['contradictory receipt and refusal', 400, { success: false, error: { code: 100, message: 'refused' }, messages: [{ id: 'wamid-contradiction' }] }],
    ['transient refusal', 400, { error: { code: 100, message: 'try later', is_transient: true } }],
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { TemplateSummary } from '../api';
import { fingerprintInitialTemplate, isInitialSendSnapshot } from './NovaConversa';

function summary(overrides: Partial<TemplateSummary> = {}): TemplateSummary {
  return {
    remoteTemplateId: 'remote-1', status: 'APPROVED', name: 'hello_customer', language: 'pt_BR',
    category: 'UTILITY', parameterFormat: 'POSITIONAL',
    components: [
      { type: 'BODY', text: 'Olá {{2}}, seu pedido {{1}} chegou.', parameters: ['2', '1'] },
      { type: 'FOOTER', text: 'Equipe', parameters: [] },
      { type: 'HEADER', format: 'TEXT', text: 'Atualização', parameters: [] },
    ],
    supported: false, semanticFingerprint: null, available: true, observedAt: '2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z',
    observedFence: 'fence-1', eligible: false, ...overrides,
  };
}

function canonical(value: unknown): string {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
    : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
      .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
      : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
}

function snapshotFor(message: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
    mensagem: message, previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
  return { key: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', request: canonical(body), body };
}

describe('fingerprint de modelo para mensagem inicial', () => {
  it('usa a ordem semântica HEADER/BODY/FOOTER e ignora sinalizadores de autoria ST05', async () => {
    const first = summary();
    const second = summary({
      components: [first.components[2], first.components[0], { type: 'BUTTONS', buttons: [{ text: 'Gerenciar' }] }, first.components[1]],
      supported: true, semanticFingerprint: 'authoring-only', available: false, eligible: true,
      observedAt: '2026-10-22T10:05:00.000Z', observedFence: 'new-fence',
    });
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(first)).resolves.toBe(await fingerprintInitialTemplate(second));
  });

  it('mantém o formato do parâmetro e o conteúdo estático no hash semântico', async () => {
    const base = summary();
    const named = summary({ parameterFormat: 'NAMED' });
    const changedFooter = summary({ components: [base.components[0], { type: 'FOOTER', text: 'Outro rodapé', parameters: [] }, base.components[2]] });
    const fingerprint = await fingerprintInitialTemplate(base);
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(named)).resolves.not.toBe(fingerprint);
    await expect(fingerprintInitialTemplate(changedFooter)).resolves.not.toBe(fingerprint);
  });
});

describe('restauração segura da tentativa inicial', () => {
  it('applies text and template value limits in Unicode code points, independently of the bounded JSON envelope', () => {
    const textAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: '😀'.repeat(4096) });
    const textOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEXTO', texto: '😀'.repeat(4097) });
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(textAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(textOverLimit)).toBe(false);

    const valueAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: ['😀'.repeat(1024)] });
    const valueOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: ['😀'.repeat(1025)] });
    const namedAtLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: { customer: '😀'.repeat(1024) } });
    const namedOverLimit = snapshotFor({ tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
      expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: { customer: '😀'.repeat(1025) } });
    expect(valueAtLimit.request.length).toBeLessThan(32_768);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(valueAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(valueOverLimit)).toBe(false);
    expect(namedAtLimit.request.length).toBeLessThan(32_768);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(namedAtLimit)).toBe(true);
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(namedOverLimit)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('preserva o limite completo de texto aceito mesmo quando caracteres JSON são escapados', () => {
    const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
      mensagem: { texto: '\u0001'.repeat(4096), tipo: 'TEXTO' }, previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
    const canonical = (value: unknown): string => Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
      : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
        .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
        : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
    const request = canonical(body);
    expect(request.length).toBeGreaterThan(16_384);
    const snapshot = { key: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', request, body };
    const restored = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot)) as unknown;
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(restored)).toBe(true);
    expect(restored).toEqual(snapshot);
  });

  it('preserva o limite de renderização do modelo após escaping JSON', () => {
    const body = { channelId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', expectedGeneration: 1,
      mensagem: { tipo: 'TEMPLATE', templateId: 'remote-template', language: 'pt_BR',
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: 'b'.repeat(64), parameters: Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => '\u0001'.repeat(1024)) },
      previewFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
    const canonical = (value: unknown): string => Array.isArray(value) ? `[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`
      : value && typeof value === 'object' ? `{${Object.keys(value as Record<string, unknown>).sort()
        .map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])}`).join(',')}}`
        : JSON.stringify(value) ?? 'null';
    const request = canonical(body);
    expect(request.length).toBeGreaterThan(24_000);
    const snapshot = { key: '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333', request, body };
    const restored = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(snapshot)) as unknown;
    expect(isInitialSendSnapshot(restored)).toBe(true);
    expect(restored).toEqual(snapshot);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ErroDaApi, api } from './api';

function responde(corpo: string, init: { status?: number; ok?: boolean } = {}) {
  const status = init.status ?? 200;
  vi.stubGlobal(
    'fetch',
    vi.fn(async () => ({
      status,
      ok: init.ok ?? status < 400,
      text: async () => corpo,
    })),
  );
}

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('resposta que não é JSON (api.ts)', () => {
  it('falha DIZENDO a causa provável, em vez de devolver objeto vazio', async () => {
    // O que o nginx do próprio front devolve quando a base da API está vazia.
    responde('<!doctype html><html><body><div id="root"></div></body></html>');

    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/base da API está VAZIA/);
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toMatchObject({ codigo: 'RESPOSTA_NAO_E_JSON' });
  });

  it('a mensagem aponta para LEADSHUG_API_URL quando a base está vazia', async () => {
    responde('<html></html>');
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('corpo vazio com 200 continua sendo objeto vazio — isso é legítimo', async () => {
    responde('');
    await expect(api.get('/x')).resolves.toEqual({});
  });

  /**
   * Com a base CONFIGURADA — o cenário do stage.
   *
   * `API_BASE` é lida na importação do módulo, então o `window` precisa existir
   * ANTES dela. Importar de novo com `resetModules` é o que faz este teste
   * exercitar o caminho de verdade, e não o de base vazia.
   */
  async function comBase(url: string) {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: url } });
    return (await import('./api')) as typeof import('./api');
  }

  it('405 é reconhecido como servidor de ARQUIVOS, não como "API confusa"', async () => {
    // nginx responde 405 a um POST para arquivo estático. É assinatura, não
    // ambiguidade — e dizer isso poupa uma rodada de investigação.
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<html>405</html>', { status: 405 });

    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('HTML com 200 também é reconhecido como servidor de arquivos', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<!doctype html><html></html>');
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
  });

  it('resposta não-JSON que NÃO parece estática cai na mensagem genérica', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('isto não é json nem html', { status: 502 });
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/não é JSON/);
  });

  it('JSON válido passa como sempre', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } }));
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).resolves.toEqual({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } });
  });
});

describe('base sem esquema (o erro de stage)', () => {
  it('recusa host solto: sem esquema, o navegador trata como CAMINHO', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'leadshug-api-stage.up.railway.app' } });
    // A chamada viraria https://<o-proprio-front>/leadshug-api-stage.../api/bff/...
    // e bateria no nginx do front — 405 no login, sem nada citando a variável.
    await expect(import('./api')).rejects.toThrow(/sem esquema/);
  });

  it('aceita https e http', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'https://api.exemplo.com.br' } });
    await expect(import('./api')).resolves.toBeDefined();
  });
});

describe('falha do servidor (o 500 do Nest)', () => {
  it('usa `message` quando não há `error`, e SEMPRE mostra o status', async () => {
    // Formato do 500 do Nest. Antes, isto virava "Falha inesperada." — que não
    // dizia nem que era 500.
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' }), { status: 500 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow('Internal server error (HTTP 500)');
  });

  it('sem `error` e sem `message`, diz o status mesmo assim', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 502 }), { status: 502 });
    await expect(api.get('/x')).rejects.toThrow(/respondeu 502 sem explicar/);
  });

  it('recusa do produto continua mostrando a mensagem do produto', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ error: 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.', code: 'CREDENCIAL_INVALIDA' }), { status: 401 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/E-mail ou senha inválidos/);
  });

  it('retém outcome e metadados seguros de incerteza', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'O envio não foi confirmado.', code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID',
      localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    }), { status: 503 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/messages', { texto: 'draft' })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    });
  });
});

describe('incerteza local segura em operação de modelo', () => {
  it('preserva operationId e certeza de ACK sem copiar metadados arbitrários', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      operationId: 'f01ba7da-8869-4f97-a7d4-c68cc057d765',
      phase: 'ACCEPTED', outcome: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',

describe('metadados permitidos para recuperação do primeiro envio', () => {
  it('preserva tentativa, estado e prazo sem copiar metadados não permitidos', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z', credential: 'must-not-be-copied',
    }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z',
    });
  });

  it('preserva apenas o sinal booleano de recusa comprovada antes da reserva', async () => {

    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({

      state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED',
    });

});
```

```typescript
import { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

const FIXTURES = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101';
const FIXTURE_TOKEN = 'timeline-provider-port-only';

async function seed(request: APIRequestContext, data: Record<string, unknown> = { count: 0 }) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/seed`, { data });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
  return response.json() as Promise<{ email: string; password: string; userId: string; businessUnitId: string; phoneNumberId: string; conversationId: string; otherConversationId: string }>;
}

function initialSendCount(records: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>, phoneNumberId: string) {
  return records.filter((record) => record.operation === 'meta.initial.send' && record.phoneNumberId === phoneNumberId).length;
}

function resourceCallCount(records: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>, phoneNumberId: string) {
  return records.filter((record) => record.phoneNumberId === phoneNumberId).length;
}

function watchSafeBffEndpoint(page: Page, pathname: string) {
  const events: Array<{ kind: 'response' | 'request-failed'; status?: number; code?: string; state?: string; preAdmission?: boolean; failure?: string }> = [];
  const pending: Promise<void>[] = [];
  page.on('response', (response) => {
    if (new URL(response.url()).pathname !== pathname) return;
    const event: (typeof events)[number] = { kind: 'response', status: response.status() };
    events.push(event);
    pending.push(response.json().then((body: unknown) => {
      if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) return;
      const safe = body as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof safe.code === 'string') event.code = safe.code.slice(0, 80);
      if (typeof safe.state === 'string') event.state = safe.state.slice(0, 80);
      if (typeof safe.preAdmission === 'boolean') event.preAdmission = safe.preAdmission;
    }).catch(() => undefined));
  });
  page.on('requestfailed', (request) => {
    if (new URL(request.url()).pathname === pathname) events.push({ kind: 'request-failed', failure: request.failure()?.errorText?.slice(0, 160) });
  });
  return async () => { await Promise.all(pending); return events; };
}

async function waitForOpenResponse(page: Page, buId: string, diagnostics: () => Promise<unknown>) {
  const pathname = `/api/bff/business-units/${buId}/conversations/open`;
  try {
    return await page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === pathname, { timeout: 15_000 });
  } catch {
    const context = await page.evaluate((expectedBu) => {
      const bu = document.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>('select[aria-label="Business Unit"]');
      const dialog = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="dialog"]');
      const submit = dialog ? Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button')).find((button) => button.type === 'submit') : undefined;
      return {
        selectedBu: bu?.value ?? null,
        expectedBu,
        modalVisible: Boolean(dialog && dialog.getClientRects().length),
        submitButtonLabel: submit?.textContent?.trim().slice(0, 40) ?? null,
        submitDisabled: submit?.disabled ?? null,
      };
    }, buId);
    throw new Error(`Conversation open returned no response: ${JSON.stringify({ events: await diagnostics(), context })}`);
  }
}

async function signIn(page: Page, fixture: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof seed>>) {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(fixture.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(fixture.password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
  await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
}

    const openedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    const { conversaId } = await (await openedResponse).json() as { conversaId: string };
    const channelSelect = page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado');
    const channelId = await channelSelect.locator('option').nth(1).getAttribute('value');
    expect(channelId).toBeTruthy();
    await channelSelect.selectOption(channelId!);
    await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill('Snapshot persistido para retomada explícita');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toBeVisible();

    let firstKey: string | null = null;
    let firstBody: unknown;
    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`) {
        firstKey ??= browserRequest.headers()['idempotency-key'] ?? null;
        firstBody ??= browserRequest.postDataJSON();
      }
    });

    let releaseResponse: (() => void) | null = null;
    let notifyResponseReady: (() => void) | null = null;
    const responseReady = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { notifyResponseReady = resolve; });
    const holdResponse = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseResponse = resolve; });
    let responseFinished!: () => void;
    const responseDrained = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { responseFinished = resolve; });
    let responseReached = false;
    let firstRequestKey: string | null = null;
    let firstRequestBody: unknown;
    let postCount = 0;
    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`) postCount += 1;
    });
    await page.route(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`, async (route) => {
      firstRequestKey = route.request().headers()['idempotency-key'] ?? null;
      firstRequestBody = route.request().postDataJSON();
      const response = await route.fetch();
      responseReached = true;
      notifyResponseReady?.();
      try {
        await holdResponse;
        await route.fulfill({ response });
      } catch { /* Reload intentionally discards this response. */ }
      finally { responseFinished(); }
    });
    try {
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).click();
      await responseReady;
      expect(firstRequestKey).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);

      await page.addInitScript(() => {
        (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked = true;
        const original = Storage.prototype.getItem;
        Storage.prototype.getItem = function (key: string) {
          const targetPrefix = 'leadshug:initial-send:v1:';
          const state = window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean };
          if (key.startsWith(targetPrefix) && state.__st04StorageReadBlocked) {
            throw new DOMException('synthetic storage read failure', 'SecurityError');
          }
          return original.call(this, key);
        };
      });
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' })).toBeVisible();
      await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
      const stored = await page.evaluate(() => Object.entries(sessionStorage)
        .find(([key]) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:'))?.[1] ?? null);
      expect(stored).toBeTruthy();
      expect(JSON.parse(stored!).key).toBe(firstRequestKey);
      expect(JSON.parse(stored!).body).toEqual(firstRequestBody);
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      releaseResponse?.();
      await page.unroute(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
      await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill(phone);
    const openDiagnostics = watchSafeBffEndpoint(page, `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    const reusedResponse = waitForOpenResponse(page, fixture.businessUnitId, openDiagnostics);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
      expect((await reusedResponse).status()).toBe(200);
      await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Primeira mensagem' })).toBeVisible();
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked)).toBe(true);
      const afterReadFailure = await page.evaluate(() => Object.entries(sessionStorage)
        .find(([key]) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:'))?.[1] ?? null);
      expect(afterReadFailure).toBeTruthy();
      expect(JSON.parse(afterReadFailure!).key).toBe(firstKey);
      expect(JSON.parse(afterReadFailure!).body).toEqual(firstBody);
      await expect(page.getByRole('alert').filter({ hasText: 'Não foi possível verificar a tentativa salva neste navegador.' })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial')).toBeDisabled();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' })).toBeDisabled();
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar tentativa salva' }).click();
      expect(postCount).toBe(1);
      await page.evaluate(() => { (window as Window & { __st04StorageReadBlocked?: boolean }).__st04StorageReadBlocked = false; });
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Recuperar tentativa salva' }).click();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retomar tentativa original' })).toBeVisible();
      const replay = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retomar tentativa original' }).click();
      const replayResponse = await replay;
      expect(replayResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(replayResponse.request().headers()['idempotency-key']).toBe(firstKey);
      expect(replayResponse.request().postDataJSON()).toEqual(firstBody);
      expect(postCount).toBe(2);
      expect(await page.evaluate(() => Object.keys(sessionStorage).some((key) => key.startsWith('leadshug:initial-send:v1:')))).toBe(false);
      const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
        messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string }>;
      };
      expect(audit.messages).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(audit.messages[0]).toMatchObject({ direction: 'OUT', content: 'Snapshot persistido para retomada explícita' });
      const providerAfter = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
        headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      }).then((response) => response.json()) as { effects: Array<{ operation: string }> };
      expect(initialSendCount(providerAfter.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)
        - initialSendCount(providerBefore.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
      expect(postCount).toBe(2);
    } finally {
      releaseResponse?.();
      if (responseReached) await responseDrained;
      await page.unroute(`/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`).catch(() => undefined);
    }
  });

  test('recupera um envio comum incerto pelo BFF e só libera risco após o prazo real', async ({ page, request }) => {
    test.setTimeout(150_000);
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 3 });
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('.bolha')).toHaveCount(3);
    const providerBefore = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }>; effects: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/send-mode`, { data: { mode: 'unknown' } }).then((response) => expect(response.status()).toBe(200));

    const body = 'Resposta comum com confirmação incerta';
    const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
    await composer.fill(body);
    const messagePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/messages`;
    const sendResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === messagePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar', exact: true }).click();
    const sent = await sendResponse;
    expect(sent.status()).toBe(409);
    expect(await sent.json()).toMatchObject({ code: 'EXTERNAL_MESSAGE_ID_MISSING', outcome: 'AMBIGUOUS_SEND_RECORDED' });
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('aceitou o envio sem confirmar o ID externo');

    const auditAfterSend = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json()) as { status: string; messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string; externalId: string | null }> };
    expect(auditAfterSend.status).toBe('QUEUED');
    expect(auditAfterSend.messages).toHaveLength(4);
    const uncertainOutbound = auditAfterSend.messages.filter((message) => message.direction === 'OUT' && message.content === body);
    expect(uncertainOutbound).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(uncertainOutbound[0]).toMatchObject({ externalId: null });
    const failedOutbound = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json());
    expect(failedOutbound).toEqual({ total: 1, accepted: 0, failed: 1, failedWithoutExternalId: 1 });
    const providerAfterSend = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as typeof providerBefore;
    expect(resourceCallCount(providerAfterSend.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId) - resourceCallCount(providerBefore.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
    expect(providerAfterSend.calls.slice(providerBefore.calls.length)
      .filter((record) => record.phoneNumberId === fixture.phoneNumberId)
      .map((record) => record.operation)).toEqual(['meta.send']);
    // This ordinary fake route records meta.send in calls, but does not add
    // provider effects. Recovery assertions below compare both snapshots to
    // prove that reconcile/acknowledge add no fixture operations.
    expect(providerAfterSend.effects).toEqual(providerBefore.effects);

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Secundário' }).click();
    const activeThreadHeading = page.locator('.inbox > .cartao.grade > .linha > strong').filter({ hasText: 'Cliente Secundário' });
    await expect(activeThreadHeading).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(activeThreadHeading).toHaveText('Cliente Secundário');
    const optionsPath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/start-options`;
    const optionsResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'GET'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === optionsPath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Cliente Timeline/ }).click();
    const options = await optionsResponse;
    expect(options.status()).toBe(200);
    const startOptions = await options.json() as { ordinaryAdmissions: Array<{ id: string; state: string; dispatchDeadlineAt: string | null }> };
    const uncertainAdmission = startOptions.ordinaryAdmissions.find((admission) => admission.state === 'UNCERTAIN');
    expect(uncertainAdmission?.id).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
    expect(uncertainAdmission?.dispatchDeadlineAt).toBeTruthy();
    const eligibleAt = Date.parse(uncertainAdmission!.dispatchDeadlineAt!);
    expect(eligibleAt).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do envio comum')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /Cliente Timeline sem atendente/ })).toBeVisible();

    const reconcilePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/dispatch-admissions/${uncertainAdmission!.id}/reconcile`;
    const reconcileResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === reconcilePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Consultar estado' }).click();
    const reconciled = await reconcileResponse;
    expect(reconciled.status()).toBe(200);
    expect(await reconciled.json()).toMatchObject({ id: uncertainAdmission!.id, state: 'UNCERTAIN', releasedAt: null });
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(providerAfterSend);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await page.getByLabel('Confirmo o risco de mensagem duplicada.').check();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' })).toBeEnabled({ timeout: 120_000 });

    const acknowledgePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/dispatch-admissions/${uncertainAdmission!.id}/acknowledge`;
    const acknowledgeResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === acknowledgePath);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' }).click();
    const acknowledged = await acknowledgeResponse;
    expect(acknowledged.status()).toBe(200);
    expect(acknowledged.request().headers()['x-confirm-duplication-risk']).toBe('true');
    expect(await acknowledged.json()).toMatchObject({ id: uncertainAdmission!.id, acknowledged: true });
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do envio comum')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline sem atendente' })).toBeVisible();

    const auditAfterRecovery = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json()) as typeof auditAfterSend;
    expect(auditAfterRecovery.status).toBe(auditAfterSend.status);
    expect(auditAfterRecovery.messages).toEqual(auditAfterSend.messages);
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`)
      .then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(failedOutbound);
    expect(await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json())).toEqual(providerAfterSend);
  });

    });

        return original.call(this, key, value);
      };

        return original.call(this, key, value);
      };
    });

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).click();

    expect(initialPosts).toBe(0);

    const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as { messages: unknown[] };

  });

  test('mantém resultado incerto recuperável e reconhece risco sem repetir o POST', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 0 });
    let initialPosts = 0;
    page.on('request', (browserRequest) => {
      if (browserRequest.method() === 'POST' && /\/api\/bff\/conversations\/[^/]+\/initial-messages$/.test(new URL(browserRequest.url()).pathname)) initialPosts += 1;
    });
    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/provider/config`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN }, data: { meta: { sendMode: 'unknown' } },
    }).then((response) => expect(response.status()).toBe(200));
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0135');
    const openedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    const opened = await openedResponse;
    expect(opened.status()).toBe(201);
    const { conversaId } = await opened.json() as { conversaId: string };
    const channel = await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').locator('option').nth(1).getAttribute('value');
    expect(channel).toBeTruthy();
    await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').selectOption(channel!);
    await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill('resultado sintético desconhecido');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toBeVisible();
    const postResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).click();
    const uncertain = await postResponse;
    expect(uncertain.status()).toBe(409);
    const result = await uncertain.json() as { attemptId?: string; state?: string };
    expect(result.state).toBe('AMBIGUOUS');
    expect(result.attemptId).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
    expect(initialPosts).toBe(1);
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
    await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0135');
    const reopenedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    expect((await reopenedResponse).status()).toBe(200);
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do primeiro envio')).toContainText('Resultado do envio ainda desconhecido.');
    expect(initialPosts).toBe(1);
    const expire = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/provider/initial-attempt/expire`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      data: { attemptId: result.attemptId, buId: fixture.businessUnitId },
    });
    expect(expire.status()).toBe(200);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Consultar estado' })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Consultar estado' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByText(/Confirmação de risco disponível após/)).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByLabel('Confirmo o risco de mensagem duplicada.').check();
    const ackResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages/${result.attemptId}/acknowledge`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reconhecer risco sem reenviar' }).click();
    expect((await ackResponse).status()).toBe(200);
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial')).toBeVisible();
    const state = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((response) => response.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string }> };
    expect(initialSendCount(state.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
    const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
      messages: unknown[]; status: string;
    };
    expect(audit).toMatchObject({ status: 'QUEUED', messages: [] });
  });

  test('conclui localmente um aceite conhecido após restauração da permissão, sem reenviar', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request, { count: 0 });
    await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/provider/config`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
      data: { holdsAfter: { 'meta.initial.send': 'known-accepted-local-recovery' } },
    }).then((response) => expect(response.status()).toBe(200));
    await signIn(page, fixture);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Nova conversa' }).click();
    await page.getByLabel('Telefone com DDI explícito').fill('+1 (415) 555-0136');
    const openedResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/business-units/${fixture.businessUnitId}/conversations/open`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
    const opened = await openedResponse;
    expect(opened.status()).toBe(201);
    const { conversaId } = await opened.json() as { conversaId: string };
    const channel = await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').locator('option').nth(1).getAttribute('value');
    expect(channel).toBeTruthy();
    await page.getByLabel('Canal selecionado').selectOption(channel!);
    await page.getByLabel('Mensagem inicial').fill('aceite conhecido com registro pendente');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pré-visualizar' }).click();
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Prévia da primeira mensagem')).toBeVisible();
    const postResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar primeiro envio' }).click();
    await expect.poll(async () => {
      const state = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, { headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN } }).then((response) => response.json()) as { effects: Array<{ operation: string; phoneNumberId?: string }> };
      return initialSendCount(state.effects, fixture.phoneNumberId);
    }).toBe(1);
    const revoked = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/revoke`, { data: { userId: fixture.userId, businessUnitId: fixture.businessUnitId } });
    expect(revoked.status()).toBe(200);
    const released = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/provider/release`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN }, data: { operation: 'meta.initial.send', key: 'known-accepted-local-recovery' },
    });
    expect(released.status()).toBe(200);
    const response = await postResponse;
    expect(response.status()).toBe(503);
    const outcome = await response.json() as { state?: string; attemptId?: string; providerAcceptance?: string; receiptPersistence?: string };
    expect(outcome).toMatchObject({ state: 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED' });
    expect(outcome.attemptId).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i);
    await expect(page.getByLabel('Recuperação do primeiro envio')).toContainText('Envio aceito pelo canal; registro da conversa pendente. Aceite não confirma entrega.');
    const restored = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/restore-fixture-grant`, { data: { userId: fixture.userId, businessUnitId: fixture.businessUnitId } });
    expect(restored.status()).toBe(200);
    const reconcileResponse = page.waitForResponse((item) => item.request().method() === 'POST'
      && new URL(item.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${conversaId}/initial-messages/${outcome.attemptId}/reconcile`);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Concluir registro local' }).click();
    expect((await reconcileResponse).status()).toBe(200);
    await expect(page.locator('.bolha').filter({ hasText: 'aceite conhecido com registro pendente' })).toBeVisible();
    const audit = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversaId)}`).then((response) => response.json()) as {
      status: string; messages: Array<{ direction: string; content: string; externalId: string | null }>;
    };
    expect(audit.status).toBe('IN_SERVICE');
    expect(audit.messages).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(audit.messages[0]).toMatchObject({ direction: 'OUT', content: 'aceite conhecido com registro pendente' });
    expect(audit.messages[0]?.externalId).toMatch(/^timeline-initial-/);
    const provider = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, {
      headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN },
    }).then((result) => result.json()) as { calls: Array<{ operation: string }> };
    expect(initialSendCount(provider.calls, fixture.phoneNumberId)).toBe(1);
  });

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Abrir ou reutilizar' }).click();
```
